economy.zh:
今日全球市场被地缘政治与宏观数据双重冲击波裹挟。美伊冲突骤然升级，特朗普声称停火结束，美军连续两日打击伊朗目标，布伦特原油飙升至79美元上方，并带动能源化工期货大涨。这一事件压倒了其他基本面因素——美股期货在冲突消息后反而上涨，但欧洲和亚洲市场反应分化，政府债券收益率普遍上扬，市场正在重新定价通胀与加息风险。与此同时，中国6月通胀数据出炉：CPI增速放缓至0.2%左右，PPI则升至近4年高位，凸显工业端成本压力与消费端疲弱并存的‘两速’格局；IMF同日将全球增长预期下调至3.0%，并警告‘二次通胀’风险。全球资产在‘滞胀担忧’与‘地缘溢价’之间剧烈摆动。后续观察：伊朗局势是否进一步失控将决定短期油价方向；美联储与欧央行在近期通胀数据及冲突影响下的政策表态将左右大类资产再定价；中国‘外热内冷’的结构性特征能否通过政策工具得到缓解，是中期关注焦点。

核心条目：
- [Oil extends gains as Iran-U.S. tensions raise concerns over supply disruptions](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/oil-rises-as-iran-us-tensions-raise-concerns-over-supply-disruptions-.html) 油价连续第二日大涨，布伦特盘中触及79.26美元，中东供应链中断风险成为市场核心定价因子。
- [Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rose after US strikes Iran for second day](https://news.google.) 美股期货在冲突延续下意外走高，显示市场正将地缘事件视为‘短空长多’（军工、能源股受益），但债券收益率同步上行暗示通胀预期升温。
- [China consumer price growth weakens in June while producer inflation rises to near 4-year high](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/china-cpi-ppi-june-inflation-iran-war-.html) 中国6月CPI仅同比增0.2%（预期0.3%），PPI同比增3.8%（近四年新高），内外需分化的‘两速’特征被投资者视为长期结构性矛盾。
- [IMF最新展望：下调今年全球增速至3.0%，“二次通胀”警报拉响](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE1saEVZZEdCNWlNYnZ2YXNoNU9vZWFpZWlUenh3dFA3WXVjWmFSajBTUFVPSEZFWTUxOUgydnBUZFRuY2Q2SGw3NlR6R0ZacERYZ1BR) IMF将2026年全球GDP增速预测从3.3%下调至3.0%，警告中东冲突可能通过能源和粮食渠道推升通胀，形成‘滞胀’格局。
- [U.S., European Government Bond Yields Rise After Trump Says U.S.-Iran Ceasefire Is Over](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQTjE2b0xGZGI1X0VkNTdTWmEtVUhzekN1eExjREN6ZWJSQzByN1lXMGRiX3ZKbk9hVXdJMEVSTTZkcEVYQm5TQmEzcE40bU4ydVRURG1OeUVwVzR4eXFtd2VnSEJPYzBFR0plQUxURFM1Q292bWdYbWJjMkhpSHk3V2tqdnBmUks5bTk0YVh5RHBwSWdheGktWF9KeDgza1FVWXNfWkNTNEdwWnlLVHdGRk5ZdWo2c3M2U3FsWg) 美欧国债收益率同步走高，10年期美债收益率升破4.5%，反映市场对通胀和加息预期上修，对科技股等高估值资产构成压力。
- [Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260708a.htm) 美联储6月会议纪要显示多数委员认为‘需要更多证据确认通胀可持续回落’，未排除进一步加息选项，市场解读为偏鹰。
- [AirPods maker Luxshare slides over 5% in Hong Kong debut](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/luxshare-ipo-hong-kong-debut-apple-airpod-.html) 立讯精密港股首日破发跌超5%，成为2026年香港最大IPO，但情绪低迷反映外资对中国供应链企业的谨慎态度。
economy.en:
Markets swung between risk-on and risk-off as escalating US-Iran military strikes drove oil prices above $79 and stoked inflation fears, while the Fed minutes revealed a cautious stance on rate cuts. China's June CPI undershot expectations, reinforcing the narrative of two-speed growth with weak domestic demand. The IMF downgraded global growth to 3.0% and warned of 'secondary inflation'. Meanwhile, AI-related stocks surged in both the US and China, and European bond yields rose sharply.

- **Oil & Geopolitics:** Brent crude spiked to $79.26 after the US launched fresh strikes on Iran and Trump declared the ceasefire over, triggering supply disruption fears ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/oil-rises-as-iran-us-tensions-raise-concerns-over-supply-disruptions-.html), [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/jul/08/oil-prices-rise-fresh-us-strikes-iran-return-sanctions-tehran-federal-reserve-minutes-live-updates)). US and European government bond yields jumped as markets priced in higher inflation and possible rate hikes ([WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQTjE2b0xGZGI1X0VkNTdTWmEtVUhzekN1eExjREN6ZWJSQzByN1lXMGRiX3ZKbk9hVXdJMEVSTTZkcEVYQm5TQmEzcE40bU4ydVRURG1OeUVwVzR4eXFtd2VnSEJPYzBFR0plQUxURFM1Q292bWdYbWJjMkhpSHk3V2tqdnBmUks5bTk0YVh5RHBwSWdheGktWF9KeDgza1FVWXNfWkNTNEdwWnlLVHdGRk5ZdWo2c3M2U3FsWg)).
- **Fed Minutes:** The June FOMC minutes showed policymakers divided on the pace of easing, with many noting persistent inflation risks ([Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260708a.htm)).
- **China Inflation:** June CPI rose only 0.2% YoY while PPI hit a near 4-year high of 5.8%, highlighting the divergence between export-led production and sluggish consumer spending ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/china-cpi-ppi-june-inflation-iran-war-.html)).
- **AI Stock Surge:** Goldman Sachs forecast a 50% upside for CATL on energy storage demand ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359915/goldman-sachs-forecasts-50-jump-battery-giant-catls-shares-energy-storage-takes)). In China, Zhipu AI and Iluvatar CoreX surged after launching secondary placements ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3359941/shares-soar-recently-listed-zhipu-ai-and-iluvatar-corex-launch-secondary-placements)).
- **European Economy:** The IMF warned Europe's economy is losing momentum with reaccelerating inflation ([logos-pres.md](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNLWprc2I3djh6OFotYk9SRjBFbUl1VFZJYlJMekRKZTYwRWZfZDUybF9tbDFoN1pFcm1vRFZEanFFWFJsTlpHOUdGOVJGams1ZXBwX09TTXptNGppYnROaVJFbHcteDdDaE1YUEhUZXBFZ3FtMW4wdHpEbVNzUHBYLVBNUFlRc0UxT2QwdGZfSHFPbzNUSHFnYWhsR0VXU3BoRnZJX21sam4)). ECB's Nagel expressed concern over rising oil prices ([GuruFocus](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPazgtVThjTFo5SW1qRVI3dlQtREk5Q1YycHVuOW1KQVFCYnA2VExYblNnNTNSWnBJTlQ3Q1FVYmdzTy13aC0xMmE0c1FmSF9WUmY4cFlyMkQ1eGNXUmJnSDhXZWZTWnR5dXlwRkdDU1U2Tk9TRkZFdHVIQ2h5V0RBUzdkY1pFNFB0SVNrUmpEZUtaWWlzaEF2MHBEOWp0RktUTnk0cG9fazhsWXlQN0E)).
- **Luxshare IPO Slips:** Apple supplier Luxshare slid over 5% in its Hong Kong debut despite being the largest listing of 2026, reflecting cautious investor sentiment ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/luxshare-ipo-hong-kong-debut-apple-airpod-.html), [Nikkei](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPVVNqMFhCSWdzcUp4OTZNVnYyVHBueHhTTFRTRWl6UHFBOWpFdTRSWUp1TlBnYzBPdGJqZnE0VGVxN2JnYVVfWjZWNlpkSFVvZ1M5c2tUUXctR3Y4bF9jVVRqaFM3RVhYMUNFOTItOXMwR2c3N1dPSDJZbFplbnc2djdsbmgwbzRtVHhzdk01ZWZ2eFhmRUpZV3FiTWwyM3BvT2VkV1pZRzd3Yi1wNXc4Q2ZoekhTcnVwSGc)).
- **San Francisco Home Prices:** Wealthy AI workers pushed median home prices to a record $1.7M, highlighting the local economic impact of the tech boom ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9q29j47v9ro)).

**Watch next:** All eyes on the US-Iran escalation—any diplomatic breakthrough or further strikes could reverse oil's rally. The Chinese Politburo meeting later this month may announce additional stimulus to counter weak domestic demand. European Q2 GDP data due next week will test the IMF's downbeat outlook.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻聚焦多重冲突升级与深层社会变迁。美伊停火协议在特朗普宣布“结束”后彻底破裂，美军对伊朗发动新一轮打击，伊朗则反击巴林与科威特，中东局势面临全面失控风险，IMF已因此下调2026年全球经济增长预期至3%。美国国内政治亦现震荡，民主党关键参议院候选人Graham Platner因性侵指控退选，暴露党内左右翼裂痕。国际刑事法院(ICC)在苏丹达尔富尔战争罪行调查上取得突破，BBC独家报道。与此同时，亚利桑那州一名18个月大男童被宣布溺水死亡后在太平间发现仍有生命迹象并奇迹生还。日韩方面，朝鲜强烈谴责韩日军事合作，韩国最高法院即将裁决前总统戒严案，日本支付处理商倒闭冲击银行业。中国方面，央行释放政策集成信号，贲德院士获国家最高科学技术奖并分享雷达工业历程。知乎社区则关注32岁程序员过劳猝死案开庭及平台营收下滑23.6%的挑战。

- [美伊冲突再升级：特朗普称停火“已结束”，美军发动新打击](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 特朗普从北约峰会回国后表示，停火协议因伊朗袭击船舶而作废，伊朗随后承诺强烈报复并攻击海湾国家。
- [IMF下调2026年全球增长预测，归因伊朗战争影响](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/9/imf-cuts-2026-world-growth-forecast-citing-iran-war-fallout?traffic_source=rss) — 预计增长3%，AI需求部分抵消能源冲击。
- [民主党参选人Graham Platner因性侵指控退选](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9v229434p2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 在缅因州关键席位争夺中退出，暴露党内进步派与温和派裂痕。
- [ICC对苏丹战争罪行调查取得突破](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9928zr2m5xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 国际刑事法院向BBC透露，已掌握过去三年达尔富尔暴行的关键证据。
- [亚利桑那州幼儿被误判死亡后奇迹生还](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg5x0vvrmro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 18个月大男童溺水后被宣告死亡，太平间发现仍有呼吸，经抢救存活。
- [N. Korea slams S. Korea-Japan military cooperation as 'self-destruction'](https://news.google.) — 朝鲜半岛紧张态势因日美军事合作升温。
- [中国央行部署下阶段货币政策：发挥增量与存量政策集成效应](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE9jMExpQmM2S3ZkbGlFYmxrZGhIbmdFVllEUmMxdHhvSWU1aWU2b3dERW9QcEFhQlNiNzJGbXRpNVBtb1pTR0s3cmhiUVRvaVVlUVhBRUxMbG5YckMxNFk2OXdReEIwQVlQS2tHblFsdXVYRGhRVGlJbzg3eEJBdw) — 强调前瞻性、灵活性、针对性。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突的走向将主导未来一周全球市场与安全格局，需关注伊朗是否关闭霍尔木兹海峡以及NATO内部的裂痕。美国民主党参议院选情的动荡可能影响11月中期选举布局。日本支付系统风险与韩国司法裁决亦为区域性变量。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in the U.S.-Iran conflict, with President Trump declaring the ceasefire 'over' and launching new strikes on Iran, triggering retaliatory attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait. This has immediate global economic implications, as the IMF cut its 2026 growth forecast to 3%, citing the war's energy shock. Meanwhile, domestic political turmoil in the U.S. saw Democrat Graham Platner suspend his Senate campaign after a sexual assault accusation, exposing party rifts. On a lighter note, groundbreaking research suggests bees have emotions, and a miraculous survival story emerged from Arizona after a toddler declared dead was found alive in a morgue. In Asia, South Korea's top court is set to rule on a former president's martial law case, while Japan faces a payment processor collapse affecting banks and restaurants. China focused on monetary policy, AI deployment, and honoring a radar pioneer. The Zhihu community buzzed with a high-profile lawsuit over a programmer's death and the platform's pivot to AI monetization.

- **U.S.-Iran conflict escalates**: Trump said the ceasefire is 'over' after U.S. strikes on Iran, which Tehran retaliated against by targeting Bahrain and Kuwait, risking a wider regional war. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/08/nx-s1-5883929/trump-nato-iran-strikes-press-conference))
- **IMF slashes growth forecast**: The global economy is now expected to grow only 3% in 2026, driven by the Iran war's energy shock, though AI demand offers partial offset. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/9/imf-cuts-2026-world-growth-forecast-citing-iran-war-fallout?traffic_source=rss))
- **Democrat Senate candidate drops out**: Graham Platner suspended his Maine Senate campaign after a sexual assault allegation, deepening divisions between the party's left and moderates. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9v229434p2o), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20ylnn8wqgo))
- **IOC clears Russian athletes**: The International Olympic Committee overturned a decade-long ban, allowing Russians to return to international competition, a move tied to geopolitical shifts. ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/08/g-s1-132480/russia-olympics-ioc-decision))
- **Bees show emotional behavior**: New research reveals bumblebees exhibit 'emotion-like behaviors' previously seen only in mammals, raising ethical questions about insect treatment. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/cpq309jrve4o))
- **Arizona toddler survives drowning misdiagnosis**: An 18-month-old declared dead was found alive in a hospital morgue and later recovered after being flown to another facility. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg5x0vvrmro))
- **Adoption trafficking case highlights gaps**: A couple's adopted baby may have been trafficked from Indonesia, exposing failures in Singapore's detection systems. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czxq4ge246wo))
- **Ukraine to license Patriot missile production**: Trump announced Ukraine will produce Patriot missiles domestically, though production timelines remain long. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce8klree690o))

**Watch next**: The U.S.-Iran confrontation could trigger further Gulf instability and oil price spikes, directly impacting global markets. The Democratic party's internal strife over Platner's candidacy may weaken their Senate prospects ahead of midterms. In Asia, South Korea's constitutional court ruling on martial law and Japan's payment system crisis will have ripple effects on regional governance and commerce. The ICC's Sudan war crimes probe may yield indictments soon.

military.zh:
今日军事焦点集中在三个方面：美伊冲突在短暂停火后骤然升级，特朗普宣称停火结束并下令对伊朗发动新一轮打击，伊朗则击落美军MQ-9无人机并实施反击；北约安卡拉峰会落下帷幕，特朗普在峰会期间抛出允许乌克兰本地生产“爱国者”拦截器的重磅提议，同时北约承诺1400亿欧元援助基辅；台海方向，台湾加速测试空射超音速反舰导弹并升级反无人机系统，而美国则公开反对台湾在野党削减国防预算。以下为过去24小时关键动态：

- **美伊战火重燃**：特朗普在从土耳其飞往英国途中临时换掉新型VC-25B“空军一号”改用旧机，引发对伊朗威胁的担忧；随后美军对伊朗发动新一轮打击，特朗普称之为“报复”([New York Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNem1mZkFxdWhfdi1HM3hYVGtoSGMxbWJ4V0Yzb3lrOGNlUG91MTdEaHk0VHdEWTZVUXI1cnRaeENHSEhzekJNcXpuaWJSdDZsc3hCTTM5Ym5kVW9sVVFCSHFUcnkyY0JaNXg3ZnhJZzhRekFNM05wMWY1Uk9SYllnSzhuejh6MW9FeWc5a0l2cWVkX2RVYmExSVR2SXhKeHB1NjFHWTJuTGJmbzAtRW44))。伊朗方面宣称其防空部队击落一架美军MQ-9“死神”无人机([Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNLUttSE5zMFBybmp0Z2o3UlRrbEJad2JCU3NWSS1Tdk5lQW85Q2Y1MDBla1dXZnA0THVONGhZWFFFdXdaNXJlckZuT210Yzh2UEtrS2Y5RjlMZTh2R2NZeFJRQ2tYN0Q3cGJaLTcxaGp4R05jc01EWmZOVzdERkh6dGctY2R1dFBEcWRhaXhFWEU3bWxRV2daN1doaGR3M0NaOXp5b1JVVy1fWkdSY3NWNHNVa1htUHR2enNVTjl1VWE5UkY2ZnNJ))，双方均宣布停火协议已不复存在([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/deal-to-end-hostilities-between-u-s-and-iran-faces-most-serious-challenge-yet))。
- **乌克兰获“爱国者”生产许可**：特朗普在北约峰会上承诺向乌克兰提供“爱国者”拦截器生产许可证，但分析指出实现本土化组装仍需数月甚至更长时间([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/land/ukraine-built-patriot-missiles-wont-be-defending-the-countrys-skies-anytime-soon))。北约同时承诺向基辅提供1400亿欧元援助([Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTFBJZWRRYm55V1JINGw1QUNBTFF1TVRTX19XbU1XeWx5V0hKOUtUNkJrc3AzYXVOMkNKXzQ3MklqdUUxLUhWdnFtTF9MNUxwcUlY))。
- **台湾加速反舰与反无人机能力**：台湾正在测试空射超音速反舰导弹，并为其“天空卫士”高射炮加装反无人机网，以应对解放军无人机威胁([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/land/taiwans-skyguard-anti-aircraft-guns-now-equipped-with-anti-drone-nets); [Asian Military Review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNb1NhX3ZsczVoRjhpeTQwSmtVZEF0YlJ5a0NHaER3MnkyT29zMDE2NW9VWnFabUU3Z2NncGpKTVc4VnAwTHQtUW9lNHVoTXdyNWVyRVFxX3BtUU5hZElZSWY5TG0wUFdIY0VpbkRwRm9FTUpYWG1oT1lSNzF6ZTVjTlZVakRyakpHQnpJRDQ0R2VHdDBDMHphWm5QcUR4d0RzMFl5MmJ5WmxXZFlFRUFMcFltRS1zVXJo))。美国则批评台湾在野党削减国防预算的举动是“向中共让步”。
- **乌克兰无人机重创俄黑海舰队**：乌克兰在72小时内声称击中21艘俄舰，其中一次大规模无人机突袭打击10艘船只，严重削弱克里米亚补给线([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/ukrainian-drone-raid-russian-ships-crimea-supply-lines/); [Seatrade Maritime News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOR3Z4cHVaZ0cyUFRRUG4zNWluWDBaMW9TaEFieklQQ2V2MkVLVWdQLTZHcE1SWE9RVmdBTmRkTDNfYmhObHhQaUVMVWRmZ2NaRi1CVmdyLUNvaUpVd3F2VEo5cTQ1cVNZaGxLaXlMVGZkWFVHNGI4bEk0T1RFcEFUaXdFZ1FWalVNNnhTVVpuRzVydw))。
- **北约峰会成果与裂痕**：土耳其总统埃尔多安称峰会“成功”结束并展示本国国防能力，但特朗普威胁切断与西班牙的贸易引发美西军事合作担忧([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/what-the-u-s-military-could-lose-if-trump-cuts-off-trade-with-nato-ally-spain))。英国与荷兰宣布合作建造新一代两栖攻击舰([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/uk-and-dutch-partner-on-next-gen-amphibious-assault-ships))。
- **中国水下发射战略导弹引关注**：中国媒体解读海军水下发射战略导弹信号，认为是对外部威慑的回应([风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE80NFJ6Q2JHTDZRN0ZSZTJNYlRuNk5IeWNxcGp0Ulppb01JRFNHOVYzblRHNHJ6cXZCXzNNNFVDZHFmdk93UWtYUTd1YThRY1ZTbkp2MnpOTFJpbkFId0tlTWQ4YXlLSUptb1FfTGFuY2ZOZHFf))；同时美日韩外长联合声明反对武力改变台海现状([美国之音](https://news.google.))。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突走向扑朔迷离，双方均无退让迹象，伊朗“消耗战”策略能否奏效有待观察；乌克兰“爱国者”本土化生产若成真，将根本改变防空导弹供应链格局，但技术转移与资金落实仍是巨大挑战；台海方向，美国明确介入预算议题，叠加台湾自身加速军备，可能进一步推高冲突风险。
military.en: The past 24 hours have been dominated by the collapse of the US-Iran ceasefire and the subsequent escalation of strikes, with President Trump declaring the ceasefire over and ordering a second night of 'retribution' strikes. Simultaneously, the NATO Summit in Ankara ended with major decisions including a pledge to license Patriot interceptor production in Ukraine and a €140 billion support package, though the summit was overshadowed by Trump's sudden flight diversion over Iran threat fears. In the Indo-Pacific, Taiwan accelerates supersonic anti-ship missile testing and equips anti-aircraft guns with drone nets amid rising tensions with China, while Beijing responds with a submarine-launched strategic missile test and sharp criticism of Philippine actions in the South China Sea.

tech.zh:
今日科技领域呈现多线交织的态势：AI监管与教育冲击、汽车产业的政策转向与价格内卷、以及科技巨头与监管的持续博弈。以下为重点动态。

- **AI安全与教育危机**：美国布朗大学教授因怀疑学生使用AI作弊，强制进行线下考试，结果平均分暴跌50%，引发“失败社会”的警示（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/we-cannot-choose-to-become-idiots-the-ai-cheating-scandal-roiling-brown-university/)）。与此同时，中国大规模裁撤1.22万个大学专业，大量替换为AI学位（[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/annaesakismith/2026/06/23/china-cuts-12200-university-programs-replaces-many-with-ai-degrees/)），全球AI人才供给结构正被重塑。
- **AI硬件与模型竞速**：Meta被曝研发“超级感知”智能眼镜，可连续录音并每几秒拍照（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/963138/meta-smart-glasses-recording-super-sensing-ai)），隐私风险骤增；SpaceXAI发布Grok 4.5，声称达到“Opus级”性能（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/spacexai-releases-grok-4-5-which-elon-describes-as-an-opus-class-model/)），开源低成本模型竞争白热化。
- **汽车业政策转向：物理按钮回归**：中国强制要求车企在安全功能上保留物理按钮，击碎了特斯拉主导的全面触屏趋势（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/china-is-bringing-buttons-back-to-cars-ending-trend-led-by-tesla/)），全球HMI设计方向可能逆转。
- **自动驾驶与监管收紧**：美国NHTSA要求自动驾驶公司停止干扰急救人员，称应急场景不是“边缘情况”（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/feds-demand-autonomous-vehicle-companies-stop-interfering-with-first-responders/)），行业测试标准面临更严格审查。
- **中美价格战新战场**：Fiat Topolino以不到1万美元成为美国最便宜电动车，但最高时速仅19英里（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/962753/fiat-topolino-ev-us-price-specs-micromobiilty)）；中国MG 07电动轿跑携半固态电池、女王化妆台仅售2.2万美元（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/22000-ev-semi-solid-state-battery-makeup-station/)），性价比竞争已延伸至细分功能创新。
- **科技巨头法律清算**：法官虽有“疑虑”仍批准马斯克与SEC的150万美元和解（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/despite-misgivings-judge-approves-elon-musks-1-5-million-sec-settlement/)，[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2211052/judge-approves-1-5-million-sec-musk-settlement-over-twitter-investment/)），但评论指出该问题的公平性“应由选民在投票箱决定”，暴露了执法局限性。

**后续观察**：AI作弊与教育应对的冲突将催生更多混合考核模式；物理按钮的回归可能成为全球汽车法规的新风向标；中国低价半固态电池车型若出口，将对欧洲电动汽车市场造成冲击。美国军工无人机在伊朗战场的损失促使五角大楼转向廉价自杀式无人机（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/us-seeks-cheaper-hunter-killer-drones-after-iran-destroys-1b-worth-of-reapers/)），无人作战成本逻辑发生根本变化。
tech.en:
Technology news over the past 24 hours is dominated by regulatory pushback, AI ethics crises, and a reshaping of the automotive landscape. A professor's in-person exam exposed systemic AI cheating at an Ivy League school, while Meta pushes toward always-on smart glasses that could record continuously. In automotive, China is mandating physical buttons in cars, reversing the Tesla-led touchscreen trend, and Xiaomi officially entered the extended-range EV market. Meanwhile, the US military confronts the high cost of drone warfare after Iran destroyed $1 billion worth of Reapers. Here are the key developments:

- **AI cheating crisis deepens:** A Brown University professor ordered an in-person final after suspecting AI use, and scores fell by 50%, calling into question the integrity of remote and take-home assessments in the age of LLMs. The story underscores a systemic challenge for higher education. [Read more](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/we-cannot-choose-to-become-idiots-the-ai-cheating-scandal-roiling-brown-university/)
- **Meta pushes always-on recording glasses:** The company is developing prototype smart glasses that could capture audio every second and snap photos every few seconds, enabling a continuous AI-powered memory. Privacy advocates are sounding alarms about the implications for bystanders. [Read more](https://www.theverge.com/tech/963138/meta-smart-glasses-recording-super-sensing-ai)
- **US military seeks cheaper drones after Iran losses:** The Pentagon is accelerating procurement of low-cost hunter-killer drones after Iran destroyed $1 billion worth of Reapers in the ongoing conflict, signaling a shift from expensive high-end systems to disposable swarms. [Read more](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/us-seeks-cheaper-hunter-killer-drones-after-iran-destroys-1b-worth-of-reapers/)
- **China mandates physical buttons in cars:** New regulations will require automakers to include physical controls for safety-critical functions, effectively ending the industry's race to replace everything with touchscreens. The move affects global brands designing for the Chinese market. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/china-is-bringing-buttons-back-to-cars-ending-trend-led-by-tesla/)
- **Xiaomi enters the EREV race with Sky Nomad:** The company confirmed its extended-range electric vehicle brand, targeting a full-size SUV with over 1,500 km of combined range, setting up a direct challenge to Li Auto and Huawei-backed Aito in China's family SUV segment. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/xiaomi-sky-nomad-erev-brand-official/)
- **Global AI industry falls short on safety standards:** A think tank report warns that the AI industry is not doing enough to ensure safety, with insufficient testing and transparency. The finding comes as regulators worldwide scramble to catch up with deployment speeds. [Read more](https://news.google.)
- **Sunrun wants to turn homes into AI data centers:** The solar company proposes using thousands of solar-powered homes to host distributed AI compute, paying homeowners for the electricity and compute capacity. A novel but potentially controversial model for AI infrastructure. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/sunrun-wants-to-pay-you-to-turn-your-home-into-an-ai-data-center/)
- **Feds crack down on autonomous vehicles blocking first responders:** The NHTSA explicitly states that emergency scenes are not "edge cases" and demands AV companies stop interfering with police, fire, and ambulance operations, signaling stricter enforcement. [Read more](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/feds-demand-autonomous-vehicle-companies-stop-interfering-with-first-responders/)

**Watch next:** The convergence of AI with wearables and automotive will likely trigger new privacy regulations. Also, watch for US Department of Defense drone procurement decisions and China's reaction to its own AI cheating epidemic. The next 48 hours could bring further fallout from the Brown University case and the Meta glasses leak.

sports.zh:
世界杯休赛日，赛场外的故事比场上更精彩。英格兰首相斯塔默暗示若夺冠将全国放假，但前提是"别先毒奶"——这背后是民意与政治的双重押注。与此同时，埃及足协公开指控裁判偏袒阿根廷和梅西，让原本趋于平静的淘汰赛备战陡增争议。转会市场同样没有假期：切尔西官宣4000万英镑签下葡萄牙新星昆达，纽卡队长吉马良斯则向俱乐部摊牌要去阿森纳。女足方面，巴萨传奇普特拉斯加盟伦敦城雌狮，被视为WSL史上最具分量的引援之一。温网赛场，英国外卡选手费里历史性闯入四强，创造46年来本土男子选手最佳战绩。残奥传奇斯托里宣布从国际赛场退役，51枚奖牌画上句号。虎扑社区则被G2击败T1刷屏，电竞评分系统俨然成为新的社交货币。

- [世界杯半程总结：超级球星、政治与补水暂停](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561711/world-cup-2026-superstar-players-politics-and-hydration-breaks-among-the-standout-themes-of-tournament-so-far) ——Sky Sports的梳理点出本届赛事的高温度、补水规则以及场外政治角力。
- [斯塔默暗示英格兰夺冠可能放假](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20y9g2v2wvo) ——首相本人对"毒奶"心有余悸，但若进决赛"可以再问一次"。
- [埃及指责阿根廷受优待，梅西被特殊保护](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2wkwd7e6go) ——埃及的申诉令国际足联面临压力，但缺乏实质性证据。
- [切尔西官宣4000万签下昆达](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3vy0v39qkko) ——18岁边锋成为蓝军今夏第三签，马雷斯卡的年轻化路线愈发清晰。
- [吉马良斯告知纽卡想去阿森纳](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561780/bruno-guimaraes-transfer-news-newcastle-captain-tells-club-he-wants-to-join-arsenal-after-world-cup-exit-with-brazil) ——巴西国脚在世界杯出局后加速转会，阿森纳若签下将补齐中场最后短板。
- [普特拉斯加盟伦敦城雌狮](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn75ndvd1y3o) ——两届金球奖得主选择次级别联赛球队，背后是女足商业版图的颠覆性实验。
- [温网：外卡黑马费里杀入四强](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/cm2dgm39mz6o) ——22岁的英国选手成为公开赛年代第二位闯入温网半决赛的本土外卡球员。
- [残奥巨星斯托里退役](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cy047zjr5rqo) ——47岁的英国女车手共获29金，是英国最成功的残奥运动员。

**后续观察**：世界杯四分之一决赛即将开打，英格兰对阵挪威、阿根廷对埃及的场外争议可能演变为场内火药桶。转会窗方面，吉马良斯的去向将牵动英超中下游格局；普特拉斯的加盟是否引发女足转会连锁反应，值得持续跟踪。温网男单四强已定，费里的奇迹能否延续至决赛？
sports.en:
The past 24 hours in sports were dominated by World Cup 2026 quarterfinal anticipation, major transfer moves in European football, and a surge of esports excitement on Chinese community platforms. As the tournament rests, political signals, golden boot narratives, and allegations of favoritism shape the global conversation, while club football prepares for seismic shifts in its summer window.

- **World Cup 2026: Quarterfinal stage set under themes of superstars, politics, and hydration breaks** – A rest day allows reflection on the biggest-ever edition, with [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561711/world-cup-2026-superstar-players-politics-and-hydration-breaks-among-the-standout-themes-of-tournament-so-far) identifying key narratives. [Chris Sutton predicts](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c15y1j32jxko) quarterfinal outcomes including England vs. Norway. Prime Minister [Starmer hints at a bank holiday](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20y9g2v2wvo) if England wins, though he refuses to “jinx it.”
- **Argentina faces allegations of favourable treatment** – Egypt has claimed bias toward Messi and Argentina at the World Cup, raising questions about refereeing and scheduling ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2wkwd7e6go) ) that could impact semifinal lineups.
- **Golden Boot race tightens** – An open field of contenders makes the scoring title one of the most competitive in recent memory, with [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8m526mjmeo) tracking the chase.
- **Chelsea seals £40m Quenda signing** – The Blues have announced the acquisition of Sporting winger Geovany Quenda, a statement of intent for the next campaign ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3vy0v39qkko) ).
- **Putellas moves to London City Lionesses** – In a landmark WSL transfer, Alexia Putellas joins the second-tier side, a move that reshapes women’s football power dynamics ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn75ndvd1y3o) ).
- **Bruno Guimaraes tells Newcastle he wants Arsenal** – The Brazilian captain’s desire to leave has been confirmed to Sky Sports, setting off a potential bidding war ( [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561780/bruno-guimaraes-transfer-news-newcastle-captain-tells-club-he-wants-to-join-arsenal-after-world-cup-exit-with-brazil) ).
- **Esports upset: G2 defeats T1** – The victory ignites a rating frenzy on Hupu, dominating the community feed with multiple threads ( [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9JWll1T24tTm41RXVYQXZJRjdUSlROaUFXN0RxZUpVbWF3cmNMOHFaY2pGM200bGo5am1sSi1EekFueFZTSmZHV0hkdmIxdUxBS3YyT2RGeUZWb2tBYTNFMUplQ1FHNnRnLVFSQTNud2dJQQ) ) – a reminder of the growing crossover between traditional sports fandom and competitive gaming.
- **Leeds United signs Harry Wilson on free transfer** – The Wales international joins after leaving Fulham, bolstering Leeds’ attacking options ( [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561731/harry-wilson-to-leeds-united-wales-international-makes-elland-road-switch-after-leaving-fulham) ).

**Watch next:** The World Cup quarterfinals kick off imminently, with geopolitical and sporting stakes high. The summer transfer window will accelerate as players return from international duty. On the esports side, PGS10 continues, and 虎扑 communities will likely amplify reactions to both football and gaming results.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条聚焦于多起纠纷与行业震荡。欧美方面，Justin Baldoni 时隔两年首度打破沉默，公开谈及与 Blake Lively 的法律战，称经历“太多痛苦之事”；CAA 公开抨击 Meta 旗下 AI 图像生成器 Muse Image 的“默许许可”政策，引发明星肖像权新争议。日韩方面，《Solo Leveling》真人剧选角再添 Rain 与李星民，朴智贤确认与宋仲基搭档新剧《Love Cloud》。中国娱乐圈传出“明星集体失业”热议，横店影视基地被指冷清；同时 NCT 中国成员昀昀宣布退出组合，与 SM 解约。微博社区则爆发关于“广西灾情热搜被明星私生活挤压”的争论，杨紫、赵丽颖、王源等人的热搜遭网友质疑。

- [Justin Baldoni 首度发声：与 Blake Lively 法律战中“有很多痛苦的事”](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/justin-baldoni-speaks-out-blake-lively-it-ends-with-us-1236805355/) 并同步在 Instagram 发布视频，其妻也一同出镜。
- [CAA 公开抨击 Meta 的 Muse Image AI 模型](https://deadline.com/2026/07/caa-slams-meta-muse-image-ai-1236978047/) 以“默许许可”使用 Instagram 公开账户内容，要求改为“明确同意”。
- [《Dune: Part Three》官方预告释出](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/dune-part-3-trailer-timothee-chalamet-zendaya-1235591154/)，Timothée Chalamet 演绎 20 年后的暴君 Paul Atreides，冲突升级。
- [Rain 与李星民有望加盟《Solo Leveling》真人剧](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853349wpp/rain-in-talks-lee-sung-min-reported-to-star-in-solo-leveling-drama-adaptation-with-byeon-woo-seok)，与边佑锡共同主演。
- [中国明星“集体失业”？横店影视基地拍摄量锐减](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9ock1Id3FKX1BCdHVaN2JMTDNURkEtM2JYdUVpLUVpZWJOS2tlN0Z5T0FjS3BWMWt1eW96Q0JCcHA3RmxRaGhFakFyMXpiM2pQWk9BTDZ6SURuZnlyb0HSAWNBVV95cUxPMjN6b0JINmNtM3pRWVh3RTJHcU9DVEE2MzFnQXJwZUstT3JLU0lXanNPSUpyeGNYREdDbXRLOEQtaHFiaUVSYTRyNmtLR0FLWG9qcFFZdnUwMGc0bmpnNXZveHc)，引发行业寒冬讨论。
- [微博用户对比广西5万人受灾与鹿晗私生活热搜占比](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE8tdjktSlNhUHluNVllcExGYkZ0TUJPTTRKOGpXaVdDT1BVMGRyalpoOVBXa2VnQmxEOS1nN3Rsd1BMdTltVzlobVZmQTUxaTlkNkQwYWFWcExHanZKWkFSUmo2MjNmblRUT2c)，批评平台娱乐至上的流量机制。

后续观察：Justin Baldoni 的公共化转身可能加速法律和解或舆论战；CAA 与 Meta 的博弈将影响 AI 生成内容的合规边界；中国“演员失业论”若持续发酵，或倒逼行业调整产能与薪酬结构。
entertainment.en:
The past 24 hours in entertainment are dominated by a heightened conflict between Hollywood talent agencies and Meta over AI ethics, the fallout from the Blake Lively–Justin Baldoni legal saga, and a strong Emmy nominations showing for Disney. In Asia, major K-drama casting news and a wave of Chinese fan debates over celebrity prioritization versus social responsibility command attention. Meanwhile, the Chinese industry faces speculation about a downturn as reports claim 'stars are collectively unemployed.'

- **Emmy nominations: Disney leads with 125 noms**; notable nods for Youn Yuh Jung (Beef 2) highlight continued international recognition ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/disney-debra-oconnell-emmy-dancing-with-the-stars-fx-hulu-1236805393/), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853350wpp/youn-yuh-jung-nominated-for-78th-emmy-awards)).
- **CAA escalates fight against Meta’s Muse AI**, calling the opt-out privacy policy unacceptable and demanding explicit consent for using public Instagram handles to generate images ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/digital/news/caa-slams-meta-opt-out-ai-muse-image-1236805387/), [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/caa-slams-meta-muse-image-ai-1236978047/)).
- **Justin Baldoni breaks silence on the Blake Lively legal battle**, describing 'so many painful things'; his wife Emily adds they wrestled with 'injustice and pain' over two years ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/justin-baldoni-breaks-silence-blake-lively-legal-battle-1236978066/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/justin-baldoni-speaks-out-blake-lively-it-ends-with-us-1236805355/)).
- **Timothée Chalamet returns as a megalomaniacal Paul Atreides** in the official Dune: Part Three trailer, set nearly 20 years into the future ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/dune-part-3-trailer-timothee-chalamet-zendaya-1235591154/)).
- **Netflix’s I Will Find You scores 74.1M views in 18 days**; series chief confirms no sophomore slump for The Night Agent but defends cancellation of The Boroughs ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/the-boroughs-cancellation-virgin-river-harlan-coben-netflix-1236977993/)).
- **K-drama casting heats up**: Park Ji Hyun reunites with Song Joong Ki in KBS’s Love Cloud, while Rain is in talks for Solo Leveling alongside Byeon Woo Seok ([Soompi1](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853348wpp/park-ji-hyun-confirmed-to-reunite-with-song-joong-ki-in-new-romance-drama), [Soompi2](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853349wpp/rain-in-talks-lee-sung-min-reported-to-star-in-solo-leveling-drama-adaptation-with-byeon-woo-seok)).
- **Chinese Weibo erupts over celebrity vs. crisis**: Lu Han’s personal life dominates trends while 50,000 people are displaced in Guangxi, and Yang Zi is criticized for posting entertainment content on the anniversary of the Marco Polo Bridge Incident ([Weibo1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE8tdjktSlNhUHluNVllcExGYkZ0TUJPTTRKOGpXaVdDT1BVMGRyalpoOVBXa2VnQmxEOS1nN3Rsd1BMdTltVzlobVZmQTUxaTlkNkQwYWFWcExHanZKWkFSUmo2MjNmblRUT2c), [Weibo2](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBtRW1qQy1uTlJ3aEJMc25WT1JPMHBFSWxBTlQ2bEYxQmhFUE4yb05SZTFDMUdxdzdyN1VmVHpVcGQtTnBoMDd1WTNpMnlFZnVuMWxtVU1qQzlvRnQ4Tm0ycDhoOA)).
- **Reports claim China's entertainment industry is in a slump** with 'stars collectively unemployed' and 'Chinese Hollywood empty'; a tax-evading male star resurfaces after four years on a magazine cover ([aboluowang](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9ock1Id3FKX1BCdHVaN2JMTDNURkEtM2JYdUVpLUVpZWJOS2tlN0Z5T0FjS3BWMWt1eW96Q0JCcHA3RmxRaGhFakFyMXpiM2pQWk9BTDZ6SURuZnlyb0HSAWNBVV95cUxPMjN6b0JINmNtM3pRWVh3RTJHcU9DVEE2MzFnQXJwZUstT3JLU0lXanNPSUpyeGNYREdDbXRLOEQtaHFiaUVSYTRyNmtLR0FLWG9qcFFZdnUwMGc0bmpnNXZveHc), [Rojaklah](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9XU2Jqb09vSFh4UnFjWWoxUHNjUklBanVJZ09LQkwwVk9jSFo4QmdmVWRiSW1EUEw0NGxZTV9QT1ludVNjb05mUWcxaHRKVmNGV1FhMWI0RzdMWUlYQi1xQ3ZlNlVlVllwTThxUWhTYS1oZUht)).

**Watch next:** The CAA vs. Meta AI standoff could set a precedent for how intellectual property and privacy are handled across social platforms. Meanwhile, the Baldoni-Lively narrative is far from over—court filings may reveal more. K-drama casting for Solo Leveling will attract global fandom attention, and Chinese fan sentiment around celebrity conduct during national crises will likely continue to shape Weibo trends.

美股.zh:
美伊冲突升级成为美股主线：油价大涨带动能源板块，但国债收益率飙升压制成长股，市场在风险偏好与通胀担忧间拉锯。美联储6月会议纪要偏鹰，叠加特朗普对西班牙发出贸易威胁，增加不确定性。核心关注：
- [Oil extends gains as Iran-U.S. tensions](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/oil-rises-as-iran-us-tensions-raise-concerns-over-supply-disruptions-.html) 能源股领涨，但航空、建筑等成本敏感板块承压。
- [SpaceX stock closes below debut price](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/spacex-stock-nasdaq-100-ipo.html) 星舰企业纳入纳指后反跌，IPO巨大估值面临消化压力。
- [Goldman Sachs forecasts 50% jump for CATL](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359915/goldman-sachs-forecasts-50-jump-battery-giant-catls-shares-energy-storage-takes) 储能赛道获华尔街背书，但需关注中美贸易摩擦风险。
收束判断：短期地缘冲突仍主导波动，若油价持续高企，美联储政策路径将更趋谨慎，美股面临估值与盈利双重考验。
美股.en:
US equity futures edged higher Thursday despite renewed US strikes on Iran, as investors weighed geopolitical risk against a resilient earnings backdrop. The Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq futures rose in early trading amidst oil-driven volatility ([Yahoo Finance](https://news.google.)). The Fed's June meeting minutes revealed no consensus on further cuts, with some members flagging sticky inflation and the need to wait for more data. Separately, SpaceX stock slid below its IPO price of $148 following its Nasdaq-100 inclusion, raising questions about post-IPO momentum ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/spacex-stock-nasdaq-100-ipo.html)). Levi's raised its full-year outlook for the second straight time but shares fell after hours, suggesting high expectations are hard to beat ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/levis-is-finding-new-ways-to-win-customers-by-looking-toward-tops-and-denim-luxury-b6e0890a?mod=mw_rss_topstories)).

- **Oil & Iran:** Brent crude climbed over 5% to $79.26 after the US launched new strikes on Iran and Trump signaled no ceasefire. This is hitting airlines and home builders harder than it helps oil companies, according to Wall Street ([MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/higher-gas-prices-arent-the-only-way-rising-tensions-with-iran-will-hit-home-0a995066?mod=mw_rss_topstories)).
- **Fed Minutes:** The FOMC minutes from June 16-17 showed officials wary of premature easing; the median dot still implies two cuts in 2026, but hawks pushed for patience ([Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260708a.htm)).
- **Trump Legal & Political:** Trump lost an appeals court bid to delay paying $5M to E. Jean Carroll ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/trump-e-jean-carroll-supreme-court-sex-abuse.html)), while McConnell's hospitalization raises Senate vacancy questions ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/08/mcconnell-health-update-beshear-hospitalization-kentucky.html)). These add political uncertainty.
- **Sector Moves:** Goldman Sachs issued a bullish note on CATL, forecasting a 50% share price jump as energy storage takes off ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359915/goldman-sachs-forecasts-50-jump-battery-giant-catls-shares-energy-storage-takes)). Wealthy AI workers are driving San Francisco home prices to a record $1.7M ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9q29j47v9ro)).

**Signal:** The market is pricing in a prolonged period of elevated geopolitical risk and sticky inflation, making rate-sensitive sectors like housing and discretionary goods vulnerable. Watch for oil's next move and Friday's jobs data for confirmation of the Fed's cautious narrative.

中国经济.zh:
中国6月通胀数据强化‘外需强、内需弱’叙事：CPI走弱至0.2%，PPI飙升至近4年高位3.8%，工业通缩与消费疲软并存。港股受科技股波动拖累回落，立讯精密破发，但A股GPU概念受资金追捧。IMF下调全球增速，中国面临二次通胀输入压力。关注点：
- [China consumer price growth weakens](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/china-cpi-ppi-june-inflation-iran-war-.html) 内需不振压力难消，但PPI高企挤压下游利润，货币政策空间受限。
- [Hong Kong stocks retreat as regional tech volatility](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359938/hong-kong-stocks-retreat-regional-tech-volatility-offsets-short-covering) 恒指跌0.78%，科技股强势未能持续，市场情绪脆弱。
- [Shares soar as Zhipu AI and Iluvatar CoreX launch secondary placements](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3359941/shares-soar-recently-listed-zhipu-ai-and-iluvatar-corex-launch-secondary-placements) AI公司股价大涨但随后回落，反映市场对科技股高估值分歧。
收束判断：中国经济短期仍依赖出口和能源安全主题；央行可能维持宽松但效果有限，市场信心需更明确的需求刺激政策才能修复。
中国经济.en:
China's economic data reinforced the two-speed narrative: June CPI rose just 0.2% YoY (below expectations) while PPI surged to a near 4-year high of 5.8%, driven by export demand and raw material costs ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/china-cpi-ppi-june-inflation-iran-war-.html)). Hong Kong stocks retreated amid regional tech volatility, with the Hang Seng down 0.78% at lunch ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3359938/hong-kong-stocks-retreat-regional-tech-volatility-offsets-short-covering)). The PBOC maintained its measured easing stance while pushing CNH internationalization ([FXStreet](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQdEhxdHJONjZ2T1g1YVJYYndtZWtUdXhfU3BGaXpKMEVjRzg5Zk01TE5VXzVaR2NGLVJ2clVZaFpmT19OOWJuUjV0X3pNYkdDT1ZDSkdaWUFhTW1rZWpiMEhKb3JhSUZaMGM5MjhZUDVxbnVFSTdmLXhXTWpIZExzX1RDN0k5TFlVX3N4RUZuYUZDZlhBbXhQQXMxUzY3VHpNZEpnY0VydjNyU1JpQUxZ)).

- **Luxshare Debut:** Apple supplier Luxshare slid over 5% in its Hong Kong debut despite raising HK$24.27 billion, marking the city's biggest listing of 2026. The weak opening reflects wariness over supply chain concentration and tariff risks ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/09/luxshare-ipo-hong-kong-debut-apple-airpod-.html), [Nikkei](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPVVNqMFhCSWdzcUp4OTZNVnYyVHBueHhTTFRTRWl6UHFBOWpFdTRSWUp1TlBnYzBPdGJqZnE0VGVxN2JnYVVfWjZWNlpkSFVvZ1M5c2tUUXctR3Y4bF9jVVRqaFM3RVhYMUNFOTItOXMwR2c3N1dPSDJZbFplbnc2djdsbmgwbzRtVHhzdk01ZWZ2eFhmRUpZV3FiTWwyM3BvT2VkV1pZRzd3Yi1wNXc4Q2ZoekhTcnVwSGc)).
- **AI Stocks Surge:** Zhipu AI and Iluvatar CoreX soared after launching secondary placements, with Zhipu AI rising as much as 9% to HK$1,989 ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3359941/shares-soar-recently-listed-zhipu-ai-and-iluvatar-corex-launch-secondary-placements)). Domestic GPU giant also hit the daily limit-up in A-shares ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5md3VpUlRyQ1pIdENpLXhralNHNzN3cW1NMkdSQmJzOWRLOVBORE4zUTBSckNwWGRmRTJQVVgzaDlZRENSeUp6R0RNVXo2TFFDX1lfV0NuMkR6YWxWWmY2dWRn)).
- **Retail Leasing Pressure:** Hong Kong's retail leasing market remains weak with rents far below pre-pandemic levels; a potential Fed rate hike and capital flight crackdown add headwinds ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3359843/when-will-hong-kongs-retail-leasing-market-see-turnaround)).
- **IMF Downgrade:** The IMF cut its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.0% and flagged 'secondary inflation' risks, adding pressure on China to boost domestic consumption ([第一财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE1saEVZZEdCNWlNYnZ2YXNoNU9vZWFpZWlUenh3dFA3WXVjWmFSajBTUFVPSEZFWTUxOUgydnBUZFRuY2Q2SGw3NlR6R0ZacERYZ1BR)).

**Signal:** The divergence between strong AI/tech plays and weak consumer/retail sectors will likely persist. Investors should monitor whether Beijing introduces fiscal stimulus in the coming weeks to support domestic demand and narrow the two-speed gap.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲经济面临‘失速+通胀再起’的夹击：IMF报告指出欧洲增长动能放缓，而油价飙升推升通胀预期。ECB官员Nagel表达担忧，政府债券收益率全面走高。欧洲并购活动保持活跃，但地缘政治不确定性令投资者观望。重点：
- [IMF: Europe’s economy is losing momentum, while inflation is picking up again](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNLWprc2I3djh6OFotYk9SRjBFbUl1VFZJYlJMekRKZTYwRWZfZDUybF9tbDFoN1pFcm1vRFZEanFFWFJsTlpHOUdGOVJGams1ZXBwX09TTXptNGppYnROaVJFbHcteDdDaE1YUEhUZXBFZ3FtMW4wdHpEbVNzUHBYLVBNUFlRc0UxT2QwdGZfSHFPbzNUSHFnYWhsR0VXU3BoRnZJX21sam4) 增长放缓与通胀回升并存，欧洲央行陷入政策两难。
- [European Central Bank's Nagel Expresses Concerns Amid Rising Oil Prices](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPazgtVThjTFo5SW1qRVI3dlQtREk5Q1YycHVuOW1KQVFCYnA2VExYblNnNTNSWnBJTlQ3Q1FVYmdzTy13aC0xMmE0c1FmSF9WUmY4cFlyMkQ1eGNXUmJnSDhXZWZTWnR5dXlwRkdDU1U2Tk9TRkZFdHVIQ2h5V0RBUzdkY1pFNFB0SVNrUmpEZUtaWWlzaEF2MHBEOWp0RktUTnk0cG9fazhsWXlQN0E) 鹰派委员警告油价通过能源成本传导至核心通胀，加息必要性上升。
- [European M&A maintains momentum amid broader market uncertainty](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxNbG42cjEzYThNVTc4V0tDdjVIdHJTWWM2Y2dmWU9hVFpEV0VDT0tsR3JmNVhMT2hCT1l2cjZob3c1c1IyRVRlRFJmQ0VsdjdkdG9IaUJpTVV3TXZrSDlsY0NkdFBORnFLdUtZR09JSUttcWttYU9IaGg1bU5Fd2ZieGNoRTFuRjV0TWZJR2NQSnpKNU91b2lESXdEdlpoTE9KdUVEU21mQV91VW42eFJTNWw4UEt4UnA0SUd2Ng) 交易活动未明显降温，但估值面临折价压力。
收束判断：欧洲央行的‘温和紧缩’立场可能因地缘冲突而被迫转向更鹰派，经济衰退风险与金融稳定之间的平衡更脆弱。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets faced a double blow from rising energy prices and hawkish central bank commentary. The IMF warned that Europe's economy is losing momentum while inflation picks up again, complicating the ECB's policy path ([logos-pres.md](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxNLWprc2I3djh6OFotYk9SRjBFbUl1VFZJYlJMekRKZTYwRWZfZDUybF9tbDFoN1pFcm1vRFZEanFFWFJsTlpHOUdGOVJGams1ZXBwX09TTXptNGppYnROaVJFbHcteDdDaE1YUEhUZXBFZ3FtMW4wdHpEbVNzUHBYLVBNUFlRc0UxT2QwdGZfSHFPbzNUSHFnYWhsR0VXU3BoRnZJX21sam4)). ECB board member Nagel expressed concerns over the impact of rising oil prices on inflation expectations ([GuruFocus](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPazgtVThjTFo5SW1qRVI3dlQtREk5Q1YycHVuOW1KQVFCYnA2VExYblNnNTNSWnBJTlQ3Q1FVYmdzTy13aC0xMmE0c1FmSF9WUmY4cFlyMkQ1eGNXUmJnSDhXZWZTWnR5dXlwRkdDU1U2Tk9TRkZFdHVIQ2h5V0RBUzdkY1pFNFB0SVNrUmpEZUtaWWlzaEF2MHBEOWp0RktUTnk0cG9fazhsWXlQN0E)). US and European government bond yields rose sharply as markets repriced rate hike risks ([WSJ](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxQTjE2b0xGZGI1X0VkNTdTWmEtVUhzekN1eExjREN6ZWJSQzByN1lXMGRiX3ZKbk9hVXdJMEVSTTZkcEVYQm5TQmEzcE40bU4ydVRURG1OeUVwVzR4eXFtd2VnSEJPYzBFR0plQUxURFM1Q292bWdYbWJjMkhpSHk3V2tqdnBmUks5bTk0YVh5RHBwSWdheGktWF9KeDgza1FVWXNfWkNTNEdwWnlLVHdGRk5ZdWo2c3M2U3FsWg)).

- **Oil Shock Impact:** Oil's surge above $79 is feeding through to European inflation expectations; ECB's Lane noted AI could help monetary policy but the immediate risk is supply-driven price pressure ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/key/date/2026/html/ecb.sp260706~b81aa4e329.en.html)).
- **M&A Momentum:** European M&A activity remains resilient despite macro uncertainty, with dealmaking holding up as firms seek strategic acquisitions ([A&O Shearman](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxNbG42cjEzYThNVTc4V0tDdjVIdHJTWWM2Y2dmWU9hVFpEV0VDT0tsR3JmNVhMT2hCT1l2cjZob3c1c1IyRVRlRFJmQ0VsdjdkdG9IaUJpTVV3TXZrSDlsY0NkdFBORnFLdUtZR09JSUttcWttYU9IaGg1bU5Fd2ZieGNoRTFuRjV0TWZJR2NQSnpKNU91b2lESXdEdlpoTE9KdUVEU21mQV91VW42eFJTNWw4UEt4UnA0SUd2Ng)).
- **France Political Risk:** With Marine Le Pen's potential influence on France's economy a growing concern, markets are watching the upcoming legislative steps ([Euractiv](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPbzRuT1FwT19iVWcxVkgwSndlMDdaMmliTDFVbGJaeF80YnQ4d3RIX1J2MmJmRjVWYUhiSGhxZEZmaW1UTGNkYUJjMDdQNExxQjhZampsMF85R2JaYm15VFRVRmNaVGwwdDhwMWtLTU01b2FTSW9rOFpPVkNWYXJfWHZQVU5KUjJMVjlSaA)).
- **Circular Economy:** The EU is pushing the circular economy through its Ecolabel, signaling long-term regulatory direction for industries ([environment.ec.europa.eu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPcFNiSk9VMU9OMG1pd3RIX05yNG4xRk1MVXRFd2pqNnJUY1BSVG5CaG1QX1V3dl9pXzQzLVI4QmxGYzdZYXNxdlpwclc4SVhNYUR3RGdzdkJRZlVEb01lejdicWpXbFlZUDdQbVIybFVCUDhKbDdBbHNLVzI3Vm9CcTFETDBVZGZ4SDBLSWxKaW1xVHM)).

**Signal:** The combination of energy-led inflation, a slowing economy, and political fragmentation in France creates a stagflation-like risk for Europe. The ECB will likely remain data-dependent, but any further oil spike could force an earlier tightening bias.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
A股短线情绪聚焦国产GPU与能源化工题材，散户博弈特征明显。沐曦股份涨停后紧急澄清仍亏损，千元股（GPU龙头）冲击涨停，但期货市场有色与贵金属大跌显示资金轮动。融资买入中际旭创超58亿元，同花顺小程序因违规收集信息被通报，监管信号值得留意。代表条目：
- [股价直线拉升触及涨停！沐曦股份紧急澄清：相关传闻不属实，公司仍处于亏损状态](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5VYUxseE1aMFdfSE1UcVd0cVJfTm5DcGlSU2t4V0ZQTzM1UUJJODJnMUFhNUdWVWtfMmxBWnI0R210ZUtoRXM2Slc5WW9BbnlZdUZXSTVTR1JDTDN4TFhzaThB) 炒作脱离基本面，需警惕追高风险。
- [全线拉升！国产GPU千亿巨头，突然爆发！千元股+1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBnWVF2REVkZmZybUpmNjZmTGdHb285SmZ6dDZrXzZrTldDZWNoVnIxU0QyRW9LQ21MZmtmTDZPNjA5dVgwYlE4dFNMUVZ0TjhodWEyWWNEMnladERTdzdzU2xR) 资金追逐自主可控逻辑，但短期涨幅过大面临分歧。
- [7月8日427股获融资买入超亿元 中际旭创获买入58.84亿元居首](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE40Z3JOVTVkYUV6VExOUjM3TGZhWHV5MzZRa3h3N3poWUxaaThMRmZwUDAzSEFLUzZBeUNkV1g1SzkyS3E3WjFMWndfelVyUTJFNEx2cTVVeXVPVjlXbEE) 融资余额高企显示杠杆情绪过热，回撤风险积累。
收束判断：社区情绪短期亢奋，但基本面支撑不足，叠加监管通报，后续大概率出现分化与回调，需警惕小作文行情后的‘业绩杀’。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Chinese retail investor sentiment was elevated on Thursday, driven by sharp rallies in domestic GPU and AI stocks. The 'store king' (memory leader) saw strong volume, ranking first in A-share turnover ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9iZjRJcEFnRXNNbk5nVzVfQWdabUp6ZHNadzdMZ3F0UnA2NkZKZ2ZlMkNnZUsxWGZhTlR2eGFmX251ZWpDZUoxNi1IQVZlay1GN3ZaWXJfaUVxb01mLTdQUTln)). However, caution emerged as Muxi Semiconductor clarified that rumors of a turnaround were false and the company remains loss-making, causing a rapid pullback after a limit-up spike ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5VYUxseE1aMFdfSE1UcVd0cVJfTm5DcGlSU2t4V0ZQTzM1UUJJODJnMUFhNUdWVWtfMmxBWnI0R210ZUtoRXM2Slc5WW9BbnlZdUZXSTVTR1JDTDN4TFhzaThB)). Futures markets showed divergence: energy and chemicals surged while precious metals and lithium carbonate plunged over 5% ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9UTG1aelh3b0xrRzRjNFQ0Y3NDQzdaTjBST3JPcHhsODZJWnJrYU9kZVRuUzZmQjBmR2ZaSmVyY3cyNkl2MEdRQWptXzhRMGZnb0NTam42aml4TDRKVHc)).

- **AI/GPU Frenzy:** A 'thousand-yuan A-share' emerged as GPU giant surged to limit-up, with retail traders piling into the sector ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBnWVF2REVkZmZybUpmNjZmTGdHb285SmZ6dDZrXzZrTldDZWNoVnIxU0QyRW9LQ21MZmtmTDZPNjA5dVgwYlE4dFNMUVZ0TjhodWEyWWNEMnladERTdzdzU2xR)). Zhipu AI's secondary placement also fueled excitement.
- **Funding Data:** On July 8, 427 stocks saw over 100 million yuan in margin buying; Zhongji Innolight led with 5.884 billion yuan, indicating heavy speculative leverage ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE40Z3JOVTVkYUV6VExOUjM3TGZhWHV5MzZRa3h3N3poWUxaaThMRmZwUDAzSEFLUzZBeUNkV1g1SzkyS3E3WjFMWndfelVyUTJFNEx2cTVVeXVPVjlXbEE)).
- **Regulatory Risk:** Tonghuashun's WeChat mini-program was among 72 apps flagged for illegally collecting personal information, reminding investors of regulatory vigilance ([thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE4zVlUwU3I0aktiWGpVRldGb055MExDSTBlN19oXzI1OEhFS0IzOUVHSjJHVjFkTmQweGNUZk10RGd3ZXF0VW9mR3ZCV3FJRFNSMXc3Y3pwVU1WOHVQVkJaLQ)).
- **Brokerage Call:** Sinolink Securities initiated coverage on Keda Manufacturing with a 'buy' rating, offering a specific stock pick for retail followers ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBESEZMajZOa1N4MGgyVXZCZFZnMEROWk9UWENzRWpHQ2pCRGFsTEFwX3N1dktYTWVseG54VUZrWHhieDB2TXpMMnZuNUk4d01rUWgtb0xxbTVha21ieXlybDdR)).

**Signal:** Retail sentiment is heavily concentrated in AI and tech names, but the Muxi episode shows how quickly momentum can reverse on bad news. The high margin buying and regulatory crackdowns suggest a fragile rally that could unwind if macro headwinds intensify.

欧美.zh:
欧美板块今日核心冲突是美国与伊朗的停火彻底破裂。特朗普在北约峰会后公开宣布停火“结束”，并授权对伊朗南部实施新一轮打击，伊朗则向巴林和科威特发射导弹，地区局势急剧恶化。与此同时，国际刑事法院(ICC)在苏丹达尔富尔战争罪行调查上取得突破，BBC独家报道称已掌握过去三年暴行的关键证据。美国国内政治方面，民主党参议院候选人Graham Platner因性侵指控退选，暴露党内进步派与温和派的深刻裂痕，可能影响缅因州的关键席位争夺。此外，亚利桑那州一名18个月大男童溺水被宣告死亡后，在医院太平间被发现仍有生命迹象并经抢救存活，这一罕见事件引发医疗程序反思。值得关注的还有蜜蜂情绪研究——科学发现熊蜂展现出此前仅在哺乳动物中观察到的类似情绪行为。

- [特朗普称美伊停火“结束”，美军发动新打击](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 作为对伊朗袭击船舶的报复，特朗普表示停火已作废。
- [IMF因伊朗战争下调2026年全球增长至3%](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/9/imf-cuts-2026-world-growth-forecast-citing-iran-war-fallout?traffic_source=rss) — AI需求部分抵消能源冲击。
- [Graham Platner退选：性侵指控撕裂民主党](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9v229434p2o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 其退出让党内左翼与温和派矛盾公开化。
- [ICC苏丹战争罪行调查“突破性进展”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9928zr2m5xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 国际刑事法院向BBC透露关键证据。
- [亚利桑那幼儿“死而复生”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cvg5x0vvrmro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — 18个月大男童被误判死亡后奇迹存活。

**收束判断**：中东冲突的升级正在重塑国际秩序与资本市场，美国国内政治不确定性叠加，欧美社会新闻呈现出战争与内政的双重震荡。
欧美.en:
The Western desk is dominated by the breaking U.S.-Iran crisis, with multiple outlets confirming new strikes and retaliations. The IMF's growth cut underscores the economic toll. Domestically, the Platner scandal and Russian IOC decision are key political stories. Social stories include the bee emotion study and the Arizona toddler case.

- **U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapses**: Trump declared the interim accord 'over' after Iranian strikes on ships, with U.S. retaliatory strikes reported in southern Iran. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz75zjj5wp8o), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/08/nx-s1-5883929/trump-nato-iran-strikes-press-conference))
- **Iran targets Bahrain and Kuwait**: Tehran's crossfire raises risks of a wider Middle East conflict and endangers the fragile ceasefire. ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/08/g-s1-132460/us-iran-attacks))
- **IMF cuts 2026 forecast to 3%**: AI demand partly offsets energy shock from the Iran war, but global growth slows. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/9/imf-cuts-2026-world-growth-forecast-citing-iran-war-fallout?traffic_source=rss))
- **Graham Platner suspends Senate campaign**: Sexual assault accusation derails a key Maine race for Democrats, exposing party rifts. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c9v229434p2o), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20ylnn8wqgo))
- **IOC allows Russian athletes back**: Decision overturns decade-long ban related to doping and Ukraine war, with implications for international sport. ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/08/g-s1-132480/russia-olympics-ioc-decision))

This desk signals that geopolitical risk is the dominant theme, with potential for further market volatility and diplomatic fallout. The Platner controversy may reshape U.S. electoral dynamics.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块今日焦点集中在朝鲜半岛紧张升级与区域经济变动。朝鲜官方严厉抨击韩国与日本的军事合作，称之为“自取灭亡”，这是对近期美日韩联合军演及情报共享协议的回应。韩国最高法院即将对前总统尹锡悦的戒严案作出最终裁决，这一历史性判决将影响韩国政治生态。经济方面，日本一家主要支付处理商的突然倒闭导致多家银行和餐厅资金链断裂，暴露了日本金融基础设施的脆弱性。与此同时，韩国忠清北道和全罗北道遭遇暴雨袭击，造成严重财产损失。文化层面，韩国佛教界尝试用社交媒体、K-pop等方式吸引Z世代信徒，引发“过度商业化”的争论。韩日关系亦出现微妙变化：一度因历史问题引发的“抵制日货”运动逐渐消退，日本产品在韩国重新获得青睐。

- [朝鲜谴责韩日军工合作](https://news.google.) — 朝鲜官方媒体称此举将破坏地区稳定。
- [韩国最高法院将裁决前总统戒严案](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOVThIT1ZVTlk1Vnp6dk9hRlBIVU52bFRFUDRXanRmYWtPY082Ykt4b1I2SFE0Q1k5c1ZJaHV6RG9CUHBjLWpIWWlUOTBHQmhCTTZkSjhIUGgzUEtCZ1JzNXB3SHNhRnNTTlh0Tmhtc014TFB6bUc3M1RKVUNvenNYMEtlbmFjQU9zcmNfUHQ1QjhPbTh0dmJYZi1IWk5yUzNGV1F5RQ) — 判决结果可能引发大规模社会反应。
- [日本支付处理商倒闭波及银行与餐厅](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOeHNUbWRPUWVFdEtvU3JvOXFaV2FHN1VhU2VXa09uZnRNajFZZ1hqRHlWTE5pdmVYOV9KNHVsRURPVk8xNzM0Slpzc0U5aXFxTnItaUQzU1NlUTBkZ0dycmFTUE1Ma1RzcGs0WUs1dXBhSC1GRlQ4cndkR2Y4V1JlQjNEcEN1cEdFTVlIQnE4MUJfQQ) — 数千家商户交易受阻。
- [韩国暴雨致忠清、全罗地区严重受损](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5VUzVDS0tseTZYb1JFbFk3U1hDRFloYWZjczBCMHR2OWstakNjMVoxZ1M5U0pWNmEzOWpBSUNILUZSNlNTckxPN2phUUFNQXpJZVpTSmxFaw) — 气象部门警告未来数日将持续。
- [“No Japan”抵制运动消退，日本产品重回韩国货架](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBtV1hhV1g4eUp0bUI4R3RtLWVfMmVRV2hVdTVORnl5bGZtMjVtczhuYVpGSnEtakNrWW52NnJwVkZMaXFpeWdYd2Judm9VT3ZTcGZrOTZZTQ) — 民意调查显示消费者态度明显缓和。

**收束判断**：朝鲜半岛军事张力与韩国国内司法进程叠加，日韩关系在经济与安全领域呈现复杂分化，暴雨灾害则增添人道主义关切。
日韩.en:
Japan and Korea are dealing with regional tensions and domestic disruptions. North Korea criticized South Korea-Japan military cooperation, while South Korea's top court prepares to rule on a former president's martial law case. Japan faces a payment processor collapse affecting daily business, and a heavy rainstorm damaged parts of South Korea. Economic and cultural trends are also notable.

- **North Korea slams Seoul-Tokyo military ties**: Warns of 'self-destruction' as joint exercises proceed. ([The Korea Times](https://news.google.))
- **South Korea top court to decide ex-president's martial law case**: The ruling could set a precedent for executive power limits. ([The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOVThIT1ZVTlk1Vnp6dk9hRlBIVU52bFRFUDRXanRmYWtPY082Ykt4b1I2SFE0Q1k5c1ZJaHV6RG9CUHBjLWpIWWlUOTBHQmhCTTZkSjhIUGgzUEtCZ1JzNXB3SHNhRnNTTlh0Tmhtc014TFB6bUc3M1RKVUNvenNYMEtlbmFjQU9zcmNfUHQ1QjhPbTh0dmJYZi1IWk5yUzNGV1F5RQ))
