([The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOeHNUbWRPUWVFdEtvU3JvOXFaV2FHN1VhU2VXa09uZnRNajFZZ1hqRHlWTE5pdmVYOV9KNHVsRURPVk8xNzM0Slpzc0U5aXFxTnItaUQzU1NlUTBkZ0dycmFTUE1Ma1RzcGs0WUs1dXBhSC1GRlQ4cndkR2Y4V1JlQjNEcEN1cEdFTVlIQnE4MUJfQQ))
- **Heavy rain damages Chungcheong, North Jeolla**: Infrastructure and agriculture hit by severe weather. ([The Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5VUzVDS0tseTZYb1JFbFk3U1hDRFloYWZjczBCMHR2OWstakNjMVoxZ1M5U0pWNmEzOWpBSUNILUZSNlNTckxPN2phUUFNQXpJZVpTSmxFaw))
- **'No Japan' boycott fades**: Korean consumers increasingly favor Japanese products again, indicating a shift in bilateral economic sentiment. ([The Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBtV1hhV1g4eUp0bUI4R3RtLWVfMmVRV2hVdTVORnl5bGZtMjVtczhuYVpGSnEtakNrWW52NnJwVkZMaXFpeWdYd2Judm9VT3ZTcGZrOTZZTQ))

This desk signals that regional security tensions and domestic economic disruptions (payments, weather) are top concerns, but trade normalization trends may offer resilience.

中国.zh:
中国板块今日以政策信号与科技荣誉为主线。中国人民银行透露下阶段货币政策将“发挥增量政策和存量政策集成效应”，强调前瞻性、灵活性和针对性，暗示可能进一步降准或结构性工具加码。贲德院士获国家最高科学技术奖，并在知乎平台分享中国雷达工业从无到有的奋斗历程，引发科技界共鸣。“十五五”规划前期研究指出城镇新增就业将保持相当规模，反映出就业优先政策持续。此外，中国教育出版传媒集团参加第35届国际出版商大会，英国“中文培优”项目来华夏令营启动，显示文化软实力输出。科技方面，人社部部署人工智能重大场景六个方向，推动AI在就业、社保等领域的应用。

- [央行释放货币政​​策集成信号](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE9jMExpQmM2S3ZkbGlFYmxrZGhIbmdFVllEUmMxdHhvSWU1aWU2b3dERW9QcEFhQlNiNzJGbXRpNVBtb1pTR0s3cmhiUVRvaVVlUVhBRUxMbG5YckMxNFk2OXdReEIwQVlQS2tHblFsdXVYRGhRVGlJbzg3eEJBdw) — 强调增量与存量政策协同。
- [贲德院士获国家最高科技奖，知乎分享雷达奋斗史](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPQW1aWHdzWU9lb21SQVg0R29rWm53b0JKR0s4VGpaX05JNGxmaEltWkJZOXJaRHVBU0lCV1BFX3QzRTFKcllsSWJaSTRJdlp3cHVFU0djVDl6TVhGVjN2NGc0dy03Q1ZpWkVjeXZQbTJ1U0RiUTRqaGFsSkgzSVEwV19qTjJqNVV1) — 为中国雷达工业拓荒的历程激励后辈。
- [“十五五”城镇新增就业将保持相当规模](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBBV1YwTl9Wc3Zkb2g1QTlSS282cDNpODFISHRQM2c3OHh3RktZOWZidFB5OHJzVS1SR2ROcGI0UlVkNkpTQWdKRnJfY2tXVVc0bC14Y0l3b0VrSUtXWnlrN2xEWFB2cFdmR0ZjYkhIRkkxTFBaT0YzczFaa2N5MjQ) — 官方预期就业市场稳步恢复。
- [人社部部署人工智能六大应用场景](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1uY3VtSFFpRkdnUG9mck4waHI2djM0ZHBHVjFBYU9RY1ppQ0thY1lSRktUVkxCZVZmTVdBdTJWbTNfcW44RW9KeDBqbGJxNVYwdUtBX1pRaTN5NlRWS1ZReWVyMjhtbnZBMkNpVGdrUHZiekdORm56bWVESm5Bdw) — 涵盖就业服务、社保、劳动监察等。

**收束判断**：中国社会新闻今日偏重政策面与科技成就，反映出在外部冲突加剧背景下内部稳增长、促就业、推创新的主线。
中国.en:
China's domestic agenda focuses on economic stability and technological advancement. The central bank outlined monetary policy to integrate incremental and existing policies, aiming to support growth and employment. The '15th Five-Year Plan' period is expected to maintain strong urban job creation. Notable cultural and scientific events include awards for radar technology pioneer Ben De, deployment of AI in human resources, and international academic exchanges.

- **Central bank's monetary policy roadmap**: Stresses flexibility and forward-looking measures to combine incremental and existing policies. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE9jMExpQmM2S3ZkbGlFYmxrZGhIbmdFVllEUmMxdHhvSWU1aWU2b3dERW9QcEFhQlNiNzJGbXRpNVBtb1pTR0s3cmhiUVRvaVVlUVhBRUxMbG5YckMxNFk2OXdReEIwQVlQS2tHblFsdXVYRGhRVGlJbzg3eEJBdw))
- **Employment outlook steady**: '15th Five-Year Plan' period to see stable new urban job additions, with policy support. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBBV1YwTl9Wc3Zkb2g1QTlSS282cDNpODFISHRQM2c3OHh3RktZOWZidFB5OHJzVS1SR2ROcGI0UlVkNkpTQWdKRnJfY2tXVVc0bC14Y0l3b0VrSUtXWnlrN2xEWFB2cFdmR0ZjYkhIRkkxTFBaT0YzczFaa2N5MjQ))
- **Top science award goes to radar pioneer Ben De**: Honored for decades of work; his story shared on Zhihu highlights China's defense tech heritage. ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPQW1aWHdzWU9lb21SQVg0R29rWm53b0JKR0s4VGpaX05JNGxmaEltWkJZOXJaRHVBU0lCV1BFX3QzRTFKcllsSWJaSTRJdlp3cHVFU0djVDl6TVhGVjN2NGc0dy03Q1ZpWkVjeXZQbTJ1U0RiUTRqaGFsSkgzSVEwV19qTjJqNVV1))
- **AI deployment in human resources**: Six major scenarios for AI in labor and social security pushed by authorities. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1uY3VtSFFpRkdnUG9mck4waHI2djM0ZHBHVjFBYU9RY1ppQ0thY1lSRktUVkxCZVZmTVdBdTJWbTNfcW44RW9KeDBqbGJxNVYwdUtBX1pRaTN5NlRWS1ZReWVyMjhtbnZBMkNpVGdrUHZiekdORm56bWVESm5Bdw))
- **'Born global' innovation production**: Expert Jiang Xiaojuan argues China is entering an era where innovation is inherently global from inception. ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQOUxENXkxSDVURkYzb3AtS25NeFhhUGF4TGpKdUJPRzdpQmJnMWY4WHhSaVl4SDJxSmliRnkwSjlpYTZrZGpWSjFYV1NTV0dCSjA4LWt6UE1kazY1Z3pwLTRGNlhFS1lpcDBOM3B2VXlkS2MzZzhwU0lyMHJFYWVCR3cxX2w4eDZpTnUtd3lTWEJydlRoaVNIQW93bkhVbEVTaVFfRGNsOEJBc3BINzlBVUFn))

This desk signals that China is doubling down on domestic tech innovation and stable employment, while engaging in international academic exchanges. AI policy is a key focus for productivity.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区动态今日呈现商业震荡与法律纠葛交织的局面。最受关注的是32岁程序员过劳猝死案于7月9日开庭，家属除向原公司索赔精神损失外，还专门追责知乎平台上散布谣言者，将网络言论责任推至风口浪尖。与此同时，知乎发布2025年财报显示营收同比下滑23.6%，CEO周源表示将加速AI商业化探索，但市场反应冷淡。公司同日宣布斥资约130万美元回购100,641股普通股，试图提振信心。另外，前华为“天才少年”吐槽DeepSeek面试流程引发热议，折射出AI行业人才招聘标准争议。小米2026年上半年表现被一位知乎ID此前精准预测，其关于下半年“V形拉升”的预言引发股民围观。

- [32岁程序员过劳猝死案开庭：家属起诉平台造谣者](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE1yQ1dBeTJIUVV2ODdoU1VCWVQ3V2g4ZTFyajhJc0IxNjB3N2pZRFN5QlgyRTBBOHo5M19vQUc5cHpmMjBzSEhPNFJJYlNfNm43TGU1M3E0TG4) — 案件将网络造谣责任纳入诉讼范围。
- [知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，加速AI商业化](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ) — 广告收入承压，AI搜索与知识付费成新方向。
- [知乎回购10万股普通股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOSHp4TnY4clphSm9YZzBIWDhrdWttS1dmeUJId0VWYW9SNDRuYm40QTRGR0JBZG5TTkRKTjhwRkNncFI4ZWhZM0h3d3ZId1ZSdDhyVVJYSUVWSVZQbGVzaHZTZVVpWDU3a0ZrNmo0a1ZSbkpWVGRJaEVRYVNRMzRvellEOXJ1RGs) — 每股约13美元，传递管理层信心。
- [前华为“天才少年”吐槽DeepSeek面试](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9VUThLamJySlhGZnBLN1lBT1J1VzR2V3pGV1gtX19zRnJEVHVfSkZLTjRnMnZQSWx6elVFbXQzU1hIZlVrWWlHQWtSbXhnTmtzcHliLVRxQzFCWERUd3BMM2pxN29JSjFWZ3d3bU12SDdYZw) — 讨论AI公司招聘流程合理性。
- [知乎ID精准预测小米上半年表现](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxOb05ZcGtLSk1PUk02Ty1mUXREc3RHcDBqU0txWkFMSUVQM3dYUzh1ZlZpQXh6TkxwNGtwcENEbGZRRHZJenh1RzFQUmVYVjd3Zk5xMGlEekNySmhSN1dOaTRtdDZ6VUM0TzAzLXQtaDJzWDdqa3hMUkRJU0N6VHJFMXhCX2FrTU4wMzdGQWRER0RvVFJuQ21VN3BpZmdXRENtdVI1dHQtR2UxdmljenN2QlMwTkpaUQ) — 股民期待下半程V形拉升预言成真。

**收束判断**：知乎正在经历商业模式转型阵痛，内容社区如何平衡流量与责任、AI投入与盈利，仍是待解难题；程序员猝死案则再次将互联网行业加班文化与平台治理推向舆论中心。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu's community was active with several high-profile stories. A lawsuit over a 32-year-old programmer's death from overwork went to court, with the family seeking damages and targeting alleged defamation. Zhihu itself reported a 23.6% revenue decline for 2025, prompting CEO Zhou Yuan to accelerate AI commercialization. The platform also repurchased shares. A former Huawei 'genius' criticized DeepSeek's interview process, sparking debate on recruitment standards.

- **Programmer overwork death case in court**: Family sues for emotional damages and pursues defamation claims against Zhihu users. ([Driven Home](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE1yQ1dBeTJIUVV2ODdoU1VCWVQ3V2g4ZTFyajhJc0IxNjB3N2pZRFN5QlgyRTBBOHo5M19vQUc5cHpmMjBzSEhPNFJJYlNfNm43TGU1M3E0TG4))
- **Zhihu revenue down 23.6%**: CEO Zhou Yuan signals pivot to AI-based monetization to reverse losses. ([Caixin](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))
- **Zhihu buys back shares**: On July 7, the company repurchased 100,641 common shares, signaling management confidence. ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOSHp4TnY4clphSm9YZzBIWDhrdWttS1dmeUJId0VWYW9SNDRuYm40QTRGR0JBZG5TTkRKTjhwRkNncFI4ZWhZM0h3d3ZId1ZSdDhyVVJYSUVWSVZQbGVzaHZTZVVpWDU3a0ZrNmo0a1ZSbkpWVGRJaEVRYVNRMzRvellEOXJ1RGs))
- **Former Huawei 'genius' criticizes DeepSeek interview**: Raises questions about tech hiring practices and talent evaluation in AI companies. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9VUThLamJySlhGZnBLN1lBT1J1VzR2V3pGV1gtX19zRnJEVHVfSkZLTjRnMnZQSWx6elVFbXQzU1hIZlVrWWlHQWtSbXhnTmtzcHliLVRxQzFCWERUd3BMM2pxN29JSjFWZ3d3bU12SDdYZw))

This desk signals that Zhihu is under financial pressure but investing in AI and buybacks, while community content around labor rights and tech talent continues to draw significant engagement.

国际安全.zh:
过去24小时，国际安全格局因美伊冲突再度急转直下而剧烈震荡。停火破裂后，美军发动新一轮打击，伊朗击落MQ-9无人机，双方重回对峙状态。北约峰会虽高调宣布对乌援助，但特朗普威胁对西班牙贸易制裁暴露盟国内部裂痕。关键动态如下：
- 特朗普宣布美伊停火“结束”，美军连续两晚打击伊朗军事设施，称行动为“报复”([Yahoo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNRzJ4alZONWo2Rms4NVNtLUUwQ0d3bi04c3k2ZU5OS0RfdXlKRmdhbEEweUFJaDVpbzg4aEU3bUQ2SXRBUm5GR3pzck1XdFRaeVh2aXk0ajVBa0FhbGxnbVk5SW0xZnJIemVlREtldjJHX2pUTjJsN093OV9VNTVHQjdSRl9ycHJ1LVltX05jSzVUc00))。
- 伊朗IRGC宣称击落美军MQ-9，分析指此举对美国在波斯湾的空中优势构成严峻挑战([Defence Security Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNLUttSE5zMFBybmp0Z2o3UlRrbEJad2JCU3NWSS1Tdk5lQW85Q2Y1MDBla1dXZnA0THVONGhZWFFFdXdaNXJlckZuT210Yzh2UEtrS2Y5RjlMTh2R2NZeFJRQ2tYN0Q3cGJaLTcxaGp4R05jc01EWmZOVzdERkh6dGctY2R1dFBEcWRhaXhFWEU3bWxRV2daN1doaGR3M0NaOXp5b1JVVy1fWkdSY3NWNHNVa1htUHR2enNVTjl1VWE5UkY2ZnNJ))。
- 特朗普临时换用旧“空军一号”导致外界对其安全担忧，凸显对新型VC-25B防御能力的质疑([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/air/trump-unexpectedly-swaps-new-air-force-one-jet-for-old-in-sudden-trip-to-british-base))。
- 美国与西班牙的贸易摩擦若升级，将危及美军在罗塔海军基地和莫隆空军基地的关键后勤能力([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/what-the-u-s-military-could-lose-if-trump-cuts-off-trade-with-nato-ally-spain))。

收束判断：美伊冲突的不可预测性成为全球安全最大变量，停火机制名存实亡，后续任何误判都可能引发更大规模军事对抗。
国际安全.en:
The US-Iran ceasefire collapsed as both sides declared it over, with US forces launching new strikes against Iran after Trump stated the ceasefire was over. Trump unexpectedly swapped his new Air Force One for an older jet during a trip to a British base, citing security concerns amid threats. NATO's Ankara Summit concluded with Trump praising alliance 'unification' and promising Ukraine a license to build Patriot interceptors, though experts note the timeline will be lengthy. European security dynamics shifted as Trump threatened trade cuts with NATO ally Spain, jeopardizing key bases, while the UK and Netherlands announced a joint next-gen amphibious assault ship program. Israel's two major defense companies may go public, and the US military's cyber war preparedness was questioned. Key developments:
- [Trump hails second night of Iran strikes as ‘retribution’](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNRzJ4alZONWo2Rms4NVNtLUUwQ0d3bi04c3k2ZU5OS0RfdXlKRmdhbEEweUFJaDVpbzg4aEU3bUQ2SXRBUm5GR3pzck1XdFRaeVh2aXk0ajVBa0FhbGxnbVk5SW0xZnJIemVlREtldjJHX2pUTjJsN093OV9VNTVHQjdSRl9ycHJ1LVltX05jSzVUc00)
- [Deal To End Hostilities Between U.S. And Iran Faces Most Serious Challenge Yet](https://www.twz.com/news-features/deal-to-end-hostilities-between-u-s-and-iran-faces-most-serious-challenge-yet)
- [Trump leaves summit praising NATO ‘unification,’ floats Ukraine-made Patriots](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/trump-leaves-summit-praising-nato-unification-floats-ukraine-made-patrio)
- [What The U.S. Military Could Lose If Trump Cuts Off Trade With NATO Ally Spain](https://www.twz.com/news-features/what-the-u-s-military-could-lose-if-trump-cuts-off-trade-with-nato-ally-spain)
- [UK And Dutch Partner On Next-Gen Amphibious Assault Ships](https://www.twz.com/news-features/uk-and-dutch-partner-on-next-gen-amphibious-assault-ships)
- [The US military is not organized for cyber war](https://www.defensenews.com/opinion/2026/07/08/the-us-military-is-not-organized-for-cyber-war/)
- [Israel’s two giant state-run defense companies may go public, but there are hurdles](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/israels-two-giant-state-run-defense-companies-may-go-public-but-there-are-hurdles/)
Watch for further US-Iran strikes and potential ceasefire negotiations, and the timeline for Ukraine Patriot production licensing as a test of NATO industrial cooperation.

冲突局势.zh:
乌克兰战场与中东战场同步升温。乌克兰在72小时内声称击中21艘俄罗斯舰船，并通过大规模无人机突袭重创克里米亚补给线；同时特朗普在NATO峰会上力推乌克兰本土生产“爱国者”导弹，但专家认为短期内无法实现。伊朗则被指采取“消耗战”策略，旨在拖垮美军。具体要点：
- 乌克兰海军无人艇和无人机协同作战，一夜之间打击10艘俄舰，其中8艘为后勤船只，显著削弱克里米亚方向物资输送([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/ukrainian-drone-raid-russian-ships-crimea-supply-lines/))。
- 特朗普承诺向乌克兰转让“爱国者”生产许可证，但现有组装线从建设到投产至少需一年，乌克兰防空真空短期内无法弥补([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/land/ukraine-built-patriot-missiles-wont-be-defending-the-countrys-skies-anytime-soon))。
- 俄乌战场出现谈判迹象：特朗普同时向普京和泽连斯基施压，要求开启停火谈判，乌克兰则声称已阻止俄军最近攻势([Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPdXE0YU5xU2dGTS1xbzlBRGVFWWdaeUhweFNCM2k1TDF5SXZ5UUNlbmNKOVBEUF9ZVHNUVm5rbnhXTWNMTzhuSWtLMG5vbUcxWmx1RXpQd2UxUDdwTWZPbktIU3RXTHlpLUpCc1BVREFCQmlYQ0lQMFpmTG5lVGZOY1g3Zjl4V3E4ekRTQ0NoVWlYNVl3SVUwLTd6Y0t6bS1JdUJ2bQ))。
- 北约安卡拉峰会承诺1400亿欧元对乌援助，但资金落实与使用效率仍存疑问([Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTFBJZWRRYm55V1JINGw1QUNBTFF1TVRTX19XbU1XeWx5V0hKOUtUNkJrc3AzYXVOMkNKXzQ3MklqdUUxLUhWdnFtTF9MNUxwcUlY))。

收束判断：乌克兰正将战场压力从陆地转向海上，但防空能力仍是致命软肋；美伊冲突的升级可能分散美国对欧军事资源，乌克兰需做好准备。
冲突局势.en:
The collapse of the US-Iran ceasefire dominated conflict reporting, with Trump explicitly calling the strikes 'retribution' and Iran claiming the ceasefire is over. An MQ-9 Reaper was reportedly shot down over Iran, signaling escalation of air threats in the Persian Gulf. Ukraine continues offensive operations, with drone raids hitting 21 Russian ships in 72 hours and a separate raid crippling Crimea supply lines. Russia's response and potential for talks remain uncertain as Trump pushes Putin and Zelensky toward negotiations. Meanwhile, Israel deepens its strategic footprint in Southeast Europe, and Turkey showcased defense capabilities at the NATO summit. Key items:
- [Trump hails second night of Iran strikes as ‘retribution’](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxNRzJ4alZONWo2Rms4NVNtLUUwQ0d3bi04c3k2ZU5OS0RfdXlKRmdhbEEweUFJaDVpbzg4aEU3bUQ2SXRBUm5GR3pzck1XdFRaeVh2aXk0ajVBa0FhbGxnbVk5SW0xZnJIemVlREtldjJHX2pUTjJsN093OV9VNTVHQjdSRl9ycHJ1LVltX05jSzVUc00)
- [US Air Force MQ-9 Reaper Destroyed Over Iran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNLUttSE5zMFBybmp0Z2o3UlRrbEJad2JCU3NWSS1Tdk5lQW85Q2Y1MDBla1dXZnA0THVONGhZWFFFdXdaNXJlckZuT210Yzh2UEtrS2Y5RjlMZTh2R2NZeFJRQ2tYN0Q3cGJaLTcxaGp4R05jc01EWmZOVzdERkh6dGctY2R1dFBEcWRhaXhFWEU3bWxRV2daN1doaGR3M0NaOXp5b1JVVy1fWkdSY3NWNHNVa1htUHR2enNVTjl1VWE5UkY2ZnNJ)
- [Ukraine hits 21 Russian ships within 72 hours](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxOR3Z4cHVaZ0cyUFRRUG4zNWluWDBaMW9TaEFieklQQ2V2MkVLVWdQLTZHcE1SWE9RVmdBTmRkTDNfYmhObHhQaUVMVWRmZ2NaRi1CVmdyLUNvaUpVd3F2VEo5cTQ1cVNZaGxLaXlMVGZkWFVHNGI4bEk0T1RFcEFUaXdFZ1FWalVNNnhTVVpuRzVydw)
- [Israel deepens strategic footprint in Southeast Europe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNeXhZd3QxX0p1WVpMYUUwZ2xTb190WnBwRHhRbDBpQ2RLaXA3ZlFJVHdQanhOYTJzY3dGektNZENJSmZDbXNUR2hUc3hnWVR1MmhRZy01Z24ycC1WcE5nZzNXN2x0dXZrbmVKTGlKTXJCLTdFUUZNVTBMU2RHWnNnYVJzZkZvT3dhcDlYR3h1YkZwM1kya0FhRllNT3JXYWZmZktGT1BKck1fT1ZmRVE)
- [Erdogan says NATO summit 'successfully' concluded, highlights Türkiye's defense capabilities](https://news.google.)
Watch for the trajectory of the US-Iran conflict: further strikes or a renewed ceasefire? And monitor Ukrainian naval drone operations as they increasingly target Russian logistics in Crimea.

中国军情.zh:
台海与南海仍是本周主要热点。台湾加速试射空射超音速反舰导弹并加装反无人机网；美国公开批评台湾在野党削减国防预算为“向中共让步”；中国专家再度指责菲律宾武力侵占南海岛礁。此外，中国海军水下发射战略导弹的报道引发广泛解读。要点如下：
- 台湾推进“雄风”空射型超音速反舰导弹测试，旨在增强对解放军水面舰艇的非对称打击能力([Asian Military Review](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxNb1NhX3ZsczVoRjhpeTQwSmtVZEF0YlJ5a0NHaER3MnkyT29zMDE2NW9VWnFabUU3Z2NncGpKTVc4VnAwTHQtUW9lNHVoTXdyNWVyRVFxX3BtUU5hZElZSWY5TG0wUFdIY0VpbkRwRm9FTUpYWG1oT1lSNzF6ZTVjTlZVakRyakpHQnpJRDQ0R2VHdDBDMHphWm5QcUR4d0RzMFl5MmJ5WmxXZFlFRUFMcFltRS1zVXJo))。
- 台军“天空卫士”防空炮加装反无人机网，反映解放军无人机对台防空系统构成的现实威胁([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/land/taiwans-skyguard-anti-aircraft-guns-now-equipped-with-anti-drone-nets))。
- 美日韩外长联合声明反对武力改变台海现状，鼓励和平解决，显示三方在台海问题上立场趋硬([美国之音](https://news.google.))。
- 中国海军水下发射战略导弹的消息被外界解读为对美日干涉台海的战略威慑，亦是解放军“二次核反击”能力展示([风闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE80NFJ6Q2JHTDZRN0ZSZTJNYlRuNk5IeWNxcGp0Ulppb01JRFNHOVYzblRHNHJ6cXZCXzNNNFVDZHFmdk93UWtYUTd1YThRY1ZTbkp2MnpOTFJpbkFId0tlTWQ4YXlLSUptb1FfTGFuY2ZOZHFf))。

收束判断：台海军事动态正从口头博弈转向实际行动——台湾加速军备、美国施压预算、中国展示核威慑，各方都在为潜在冲突做准备。
中国军情.en:
China's strategic signaling intensified with a reported submarine-launched strategic missile test, interpreted as a message of nuclear deterrence capability. The South China Sea arbitration debate resurfaced with a conference in Haikou criticizing the ruling, while Chinese experts accused the Philippines of illegal occupation and called for an immediate halt. Taiwan's defense posture attracted attention: the US warned that cutting defense budgets would be a concession to China, while Taiwan is building a drone 'national team' to counter the drone threat from China. Japan's accelerated remilitarization drew critical commentary from Chinese state media, warning of a dangerous path. US, Japan, and South Korea jointly urged peaceful resolution of cross-strait issues and opposed force to change the status quo. Key items:
- [信息量爆炸！中国海军水下发射战略导弹究竟释放了什么信号？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE80NFJ6Q2JHTDZRN0ZSZTJNYlRuNk5IeWNxcGp0Ulppb01JRFNHOVYzblRHNHJ6cXZCXzNNNFVDZHFmdk93UWtYUTd1YThRY1ZTbkp2MnpOTFJpbkFId0tlTWQ4YXlLSUptb1FfTGFuY2ZOZHFf)
- [中国专家：菲律宾以武力侵占中国南海岛礁构成重大国际不法行为 必须立即停止](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE1MMkVZNnMtUGNsVnN2X1pOMGRROGtCdDJqa3Rhb1VYWEJva1ZNYkpCMHY2WmxoUE9tVUE0dlZUQmR1ZGIyYlJrV1VqckQ5dVI5T0NQRWtXUnJRV2NWY1FhczR3czEweEh4)
- [台湾在野党削减国防预算…美国称“这是向中共让步”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxNY1RsckpZdWVOZEVUcDVvUEZuSm9zLUEzcUhiMGw2OWNORWRnT041MFlZSFV3amNLNldFTEVnQTBlQUQ1YUdRcDg4UEtaOGpKdE8wdV9wRVdTcXZGZ004blhCaWhHRFRkZEpuai1nOElMYTZtZHl1QklXaDVCVWU3ZEVaY29icWJHNjJv)
- [聚焦台海 - 台湾正打造无人机国家队，面对中国威胁台湾希望将无人机转化为战略优势](https://news.google.)
- [美日韩外长：反对武力改变台海现状，鼓励和平解决台海议题](https://news.google.)
- [中国蓝观察丨日本疯狂“再军事化” 恐再陷危险泥潭](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE5BUWhQN1RzQmNiYklwOVRxaDNycXUzRGdTQ2kwLXFPSk80SVR4cGRYZzNGYVNoQ2hvSEw5ci0xYlJuWHFvTzVQcENqdDNBWE0)
Watch for China's next moves in the South China Sea following the arbitration conference and expert statements, and for any further military exercises near Taiwan in response to US-Japan-South Korea statements.

海军与印太.zh:
欧洲与印太海军力量建设同步加速。英国F-35在挪威海拦截俄军图-142巡逻机，显示北极空中对峙常态化；加拿大放弃韩国选择德国建造下一代潜艇；土耳其成功试射TAYFUN反舰弹道导弹，成为继中、俄后少数具备ASBM能力的国家。乌克兰无人机继续在黑海取得战果。以下为要点：
- 英国“威尔士亲王”号航母编队在北欧活动期间，皇家海军F-35B紧急起飞拦截接近的俄军图-142，后者投放声呐浮标并拒绝应答，行为被视为挑衅([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/08/royal-navy-intercepts-russian-patrol-aircraft-in-norwegian-sea))。
- 加拿大宣布从德国采购12艘攻击型潜艇（常规动力），这笔“史上最大国防采购”将在2030年代重塑加海军水下战力([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/08/canada-selects-german-firm-to-build-12-attack-boats-for-royal-canadian-navy))。
- 土耳其“台风”Block-3弹道导弹成功命中海上移动目标，验证了ASBM能力，对北约黑海态势产生显著影响([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/turkiyes-tayfun-block-3-asbm-scores-direct-hit-on-moving-sea-target))。
- 丹麦决定采购新型海上巡逻机，加强北极与北大西洋存在，配合北约对俄罗斯潜艇活动的监视([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/denmark-to-procure-new-maritime-patrol-aircraft))。

收束判断：海军军备竞赛在三大洋同步展开，无人化、远程精确打击和北极化成为关键词，各国都在调整舰队结构以适应新威胁。
海军与印太.en:
The maritime domain saw significant developments: the world's first airdrop of an unmanned surface vessel (USV) was successfully conducted by Kraken and Capewell under the Royal Navy's Project Beehive, signaling a leap in rapid USV deployment. Turkey tested the TAYFUN Block-3 anti-ship ballistic missile against a moving sea target, demonstrating a new NATO-capable ASBM. Canada selected a German firm to build 12 attack boats for the Royal Canadian Navy, the largest defense procurement in Canadian history. Germany's budget committee approved four F128 frigates but with strict conditions due to cost overruns. Denmark announced a new maritime patrol aircraft procurement for Arctic presence. The Royal Navy intercepted a Russian Tu-142 Bear approaching HMS Prince of Wales, releasing sonobuoys in a close encounter. Ukraine's massive drone raid hit 10 Russian ships including eight vital supply vessels, crippling Crimea's logistics. A US Navy helicopter squadron commander was confirmed dead after a ditching in the Arabian Sea. Lithuania joined Norway's standardized vessel programme, expanding Baltic defense integration. The ADVENT combat management system entered service with Romania, a first for a NATO navy. Key items:
- [World’s first USV airdrop accomplished by Kraken and Capewell](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/worlds-first-usv-airdrop-accomplished-by-kraken-and-capewell/)
- [Türkiye’s TAYFUN Block-3 ASBM Scores Direct Hit on Moving Sea Target](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/turkiyes-tayfun-block-3-asbm-scores-direct-hit-on-moving-sea-target/)
- [Canada Selects German Firm to Build 12 Attack Boats for Royal Canadian Navy](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/08/canada-selects-german-firm-to-build-12-attack-boats-for-royal-canadian-navy)
- [German Budget Committee Approves F128 Frigates With Strict Conditions](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/german-budget-committee-approves-f128-frigates-conditions/)
- [Royal Navy Intercepts Russian Patrol Aircraft in Norwegian Sea](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/08/royal-navy-intercepts-russian-patrol-aircraft-in-norwegian-sea)
- [Ukrainian Drone Raid Hits 10 Russian Ships, Crippling Crimea Supply Lines](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/ukrainian-drone-raid-russian-ships-crimea-supply-lines/)
- [Lithuania Joins Norway’s Standardised Vessel Programme With New MoU](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/kongsberg-norway-standardised-vessels-lithuania-uk/)
- [ADVENT CMS Enters Service with a NATO Navy For the First Time](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/advent-cms-enters-service-with-a-nato-navy-for-the-first-time/)
Watch for operational deployment of the USV airdrop capability and follow-up strikes by Ukrainian drones on Russian Black Sea assets, which could further degrade Russian logistics.

科技产品.zh: 今日科技产品板块核心围绕法律纠纷与军工转型。法官批准马斯克与SEC的150万美元和解，结束其未及时披露Twitter持股的缠斗（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/despite-misgivings-judge-approves-elon-musks-1-5-million-sec-settlement/)），但批评者认为和解金微不足道；同时，美国NHTSA要求自动驾驶公司不得干扰急救人员（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/feds-demand-autonomous-vehicle-companies-stop-interfering-with-first-responders/)），行业测试安全门槛提高。另一焦点是伊朗战争摧毁价值10亿美元的美军“死神”无人机，五角大楼呼吁采购更便宜的“猎人-杀手”无人机（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/us-seeks-cheaper-hunter-killer-drones-after-iran-destroys-1b-worth-of-reapers/)），此举可能重塑全球军贸与无人机技术路线。此外，Truecaller与印度电信监管机构就反垃圾规则爆发冲突（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/truecaller-clashes-with-indias-telecom-regulator-over-anti-spam-rules/)），用户对官方商务号码的屏蔽行为挑战监管效力。
科技产品.en:
A mix of regulatory rulings and market shifts defined the consumer tech landscape. A judge rejected Kalshi's attempt to sidestep New York gambling laws, Elon Musk's SEC settlement over Twitter disclosure was approved with judicial misgivings, and the US military is rethinking drone strategy after expensive losses. Meanwhile, Truecaller is battling India's telecom regulator over anti-spam rules, and the NHTSA demanded autonomous vehicle companies stop blocking first responders. The common thread: regulators are asserting authority over tech platforms, from prediction markets to self-driving cars. 

- **Judge blocks Kalshi's prediction market in New York** — The ruling says Kalshi cannot ignore state gambling laws, a setback for the prediction market industry. [Read more](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/07/new-york-can-restrict-sports-gambling-on-prediction-markets-us-judge-rules/)
- **Musk's $1.5M SEC settlement approved** — A judge called it 'fair' but noted the broader issue is for 'citizenry to decide at the ballot box.' [Read more](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/despite-misgivings-judge-approves-elon-musks-1-5-million-sec-settlement/)
- **Truecaller clashes with India's telecom regulator** — Users are ignoring business calls as anti-spam rules backfire, creating tension. [Read more](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/truecaller-clashes-with-indias-telecom-regulator-over-anti-spam-rules/)
- **NHTSA demands AV companies stop interfering with first responders** — Emergency scenes are not edge cases, regulators warn. [Read more](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/feds-demand-autonomous-vehicle-companies-stop-interfering-with-first-responders/)
- **US seeks cheaper hunter-killer drones** — After Iran destroyed $1B in Reapers, the Pentagon pivots to low-cost replacements. [Read more](https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/07/us-seeks-cheaper-hunter-killer-drones-after-iran-destroys-1b-worth-of-reapers/)

**Closing signal:** Regulatory pressure on tech products is intensifying across jurisdictions, with gambling, securities, and safety rules tightening—expect more compliance costs and business model pivots.

AI.zh: AI领域本周最引人注目的是教育体系与AI的对抗性适应。布朗大学发现AI作弊后强制线下考试，成绩腰斩（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/we-cannot-choose-to-become-idiots-the-ai-cheating-scandal-roiling-brown-university/)），此类现象将推动全美高校考核方式变革。与此同时，中国大规模替换传统专业为AI学位（[Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/annaesakismith/2026/06/23/china-cuts-12200-university-programs-replaces-many-with-ai-degrees/)），预示劳动力市场结构性错配风险。硬件端，Meta的“超级感知”眼镜将AI可穿戴带入全天候监控争议（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/963138/meta-smart-glasses-recording-super-sensing-ai)），而SpaceXAI的Grok 4.5以更低成本对标Claude Opus（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/spacexai-releases-grok-4-5-which-elon-describes-as-an-opus-class-model/)），加剧模型价格战。Google的Deepfake检测系统成功揭穿麦康奈尔AI假图（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/googles-deepfake-detection-system-used-to-debunk-mcconnell-hoax-pic/)），验证了技术反制的有效性。
AI.en:
AI ethics and safety stories dominated the AI desk. A dramatic demonstration of AI cheating at Brown University showed scores halving on in-person exams, Meta is developing always-on recording smart glasses, and Google's deepfake detector was used to debunk a hoax image of Senator Mitch McConnell. SpaceXAI released Grok 4.5, positioning it as a cheaper Opus-class model, while a think tank warned the global AI industry is falling short on safety. The tension between capability and guardrails is accelerating.

- **Ivy League AI cheating scandal** — Brown professor's in-person final caused a 50% score drop, prompting a debate on academic integrity. [Read more](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/07/we-cannot-choose-to-become-idiots-the-ai-cheating-scandal-roiling-brown-university/)
- **Meta's always-on smart glasses** — Prototypes would record audio every second and photos every few seconds for AI queries, raising privacy alarms. [Read more](https://www.theverge.com/tech/963138/meta-smart-glasses-recording-super-sensing-ai)
- **Google's deepfake detector debunks McConnell hoax** — The system quickly identified an AI-generated image of the senator in distress, showcasing practical use of detection tech. [Read more](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/googles-deepfake-detector-system-used-to-debunk-mcconnell-hoax-pic/)
- **SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5** — Elon Musk's model is touted as an 'Opus-class' alternative at lower cost, intensifying the AI price war. [Read more](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/08/spacexai-releases-grok-4-5-which-elon-describes-as-an-opus-class-model/)
- **Global AI industry falls short on safety** — A think tank warns of insufficient testing and transparency, urging stricter standards. [Read more](https://news.google.)

**Closing signal:** Expect more stories on AI detection in education, privacy backlash against wearables, and regulatory moves as safety concerns mount.

汽车.zh: 汽车行业今日迎来中国政策的剧烈干预：中国强制要求电动汽车配备物理按钮（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/china-is-bringing-buttons-back-to-cars-ending-trend-led-by-tesla/)），直接否定特斯拉的全触屏逻辑，全球车企需重新设计座舱。价格方面，Fiat Topolino以极低价入市（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/transportation/962753/fiat-topolino-ev-us-price-specs-micromobiilty)），但19mph极速暴露了微型电动车的实用性瓶颈；而中国MG 07以2.2万美元提供半固态电池和女王化妆台（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/22000-ev-semi-solid-state-battery-makeup-station/)），证明差异化功能可成为低价车的竞争力。Xiaomi正式推出EREV品牌Sky Nomad，首款全尺寸SUV续航超1500公里（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/xiaomi-sky-nomad-erev-brand-official/)），直接挑战理想与华为问界的市场地位。另外，BYD Shark在英国起价6.3万美元（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/byds-pickup-priced-from-63000-in-uk-with-56-miles-ev-range/)），福特则承认其3万美元电动皮卡实际上很小（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/ford-admits-30k-midsize-ev-pickup-is-small/)），折射出美国与亚洲在电动皮卡路线上的认知差异。
汽车.en:
The automotive beat saw significant shifts in EV strategy and regulation. China mandated physical buttons for safety-critical functions, Xiaomi officially launched its Sky Nomad EREV brand, Ford admitted its $30K EV pickup is actually 'small', and Kia added AWD and near-350 miles of range to the EV4. BYD's Shark pickup went on sale in the UK at $63,000, and a review of the Toyota bZ Woodland noted missing key features. The industry is fragmenting by region and use case.

- **China mandates physical buttons in cars** — New regulation requires physical controls for safety functions, reversing the screen-everything trend. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/china-is-bringing-buttons-back-to-cars-ending-trend-led-by-tesla/)
- **Xiaomi Sky Nomad EREV brand official** — The first model is a full-size SUV with 1,500 km combined range, challenging Li Auto. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/xiaomi-sky-nomad-erev-brand-official/)
- **Ford's $30K EV pickup is 'small'** — Ford now calls it an 'affordable small electric pickup' on a new UEV platform, shrinking expectations. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/ford-admits-30k-midsize-ev-pickup-is-small/)
- **Kia EV4 gets AWD and nearly 350 miles range** — New variant launched in Europe, but not the GT model yet. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/kias-electric-hatch-gains-awd-nearly-350-miles-range/)
- **BYD Shark pickup priced $63K in UK** — The plug-in hybrid pickup offers 56 miles EV range and targets diesel truck buyers. [Read more](https://electrek.co/2026/07/08/byds-pickup-priced-from-63000-in-uk-with-56-miles-ev-range/)

**Closing signal:** China's regulatory move on buttons could become a global trend, while the EREV vs BEV battle heats up with Xiaomi entering the fray. Expect more price wars and segment-specific EVs.

足球.zh:
世界杯迎来首个休整日，但舆论战和转会流言丝毫未歇。英格兰首相的"放假暗示"虽然停留在口头，却折射出全国对夺冠的极高期待；埃及对阿根廷的指责虽然缺乏实锤，但足以影响裁判心理。转会市场方面，切尔西迅速敲定昆达，吉马良斯公开与纽卡决裂——前者佐证蓝军重建速度，后者则可能触发阿森纳的夏窗最后大手笔。女足领域，普特拉斯从巴萨转投伦敦城雌狮，这是WSL历史上最令人意外的转会，背后是资本对女子足球商业价值的重新估算。
- [斯塔默暗示夺冠放假](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20y9g2v2wvo)
- [埃及指控阿根廷被偏袒](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2wkwd7e6go)
- [切尔西官宣昆达](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3vy0v39qkko)
- [吉马良斯要求转会阿森纳](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561780/bruno-guimaraes-transfer-news-newcastle-captain-tells-club-he-wants-to-join-arsenal-after-world-cup-exit-with-brazil)
- [普特拉斯加盟伦敦城雌狮](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn75ndvd1y3o)
综合来看，世界杯场外热度已超过场内表现，而吉马良斯与普特拉斯的转会或将分别定义英超与女足的夏窗走向。
足球.en:
World Cup 2026 dominates the football desk with quarterfinal predictions, off-field political signaling, and transfer market activity reshaping club rosters. The tournament’s rest day provided a moment to assess themes, while allegations of bias toward Argentina and the Golden Boot race add layers of intrigue.

- **Quarterfinal predictions and political backdrop** – Chris Sutton predicts England to beat Norway; Starmer’s bank holiday hint adds pressure ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c15y1j32jxko) , [BBC News](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c20y9g2v2wvo) ).
- **Argentina favouritism allegations** – Egypt’s complaint about Messi’s treatment could influence officiating in upcoming matches ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cx2wkwd7e6go) ).
- **Golden Boot race** – Multiple players in contention; the race is described as “for the ages” ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8m526mjmeo) ).
- **Chelsea’s £40m Quenda signing** – Immediate impact on Premier League transfer dynamics ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c3vy0v39qkko) ).
- **Putellas to London City Lionesses** – A stunning coup that elevates the WSL’s competitive balance ( [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cn75ndvd1y3o) ).
- **Bruno Guimaraes wants Arsenal** – Confirmation of transfer demand, likely to trigger a bidding war ( [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561780/bruno-guimaraes-transfer-news-newcastle-captain-tells-club-he-wants-to-join-arsenal-after-world-cup-exit-with-brazil) ).
- **Leeds signs Harry Wilson** – Free transfer adds depth to Leeds’ squad ( [Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13561731/harry-wilson-to-leeds-united-wales-international-makes-elland-road-switch-after-leaving-fulham) ).

**Signal:** The resumption of World Cup quarterfinals and the opening of the summer transfer window will keep football at the centre of sports discourse over the next 48 hours.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
社区焦点从世界杯短暂切换到电竞战场，G2战胜T1的讨论热度甚至盖过八强海报设计。虎扑评分系统在电竞板块被玩出花样，用户争相给出离谱分数，形成独特的评论区景观。与此同时，皇马后卫弗兰-加西亚与贝蒂斯的转会谈判引发皇马球迷对阵容深度的担忧，而世界杯八强海报的四组主题设计则展示了虎扑用户的设计能力。
- [G2战胜T1引发虎扑评分热潮](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9JWll1T24tTm41RXVYQXZJRjdUSlROaUFXN0RxZUpVbWF3cmNMOHFaY2pGM200bGo5am1sSi1EekFueFZTSmZHV0hkdmIxdUxBS3YyT2RGeUZWb2tBYTNFMUplQ1FHNnRnLVFSQTNud2dJQQ)
- [PGS10小组赛虎扑墙](https://news.google.)
- [世界杯八强海报四组主题](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxOYXMtYld2ck8tZEIwb0ZTUVJkUUNPbWRKaEE5dEhsemRQdXk1ekhfZjJVVWZOYjdUZHdMMFR3YTNyYkJoanVnRkNNeklBU2F0Q3VTMVZCT1NDS1lOM05OS2ItelZzd0tRMFY5Q3ZKMHVaWkVyc0lKUE5aWk1aMGFjMnNB)
- [贝蒂斯与皇马后卫谈判](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1taVJha3JvMXk2b0ZwX2I5ejdIYTdENE81WndLdjNMa1JqMEZ0YkRNMnp1NEl3SzhkQlRFZ29ZSzlvOFU4WXNJb3l3MHphMzhWNEZMUlBR)
虎扑社区当前呈现"电竞+世界杯"双热点并行态势，评分文化已从体育延伸至电竞赛事，而转会流言的讨论则保持了足球社区的日常活跃。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The Hupu community is ablaze with esports content, particularly the PGS10 group stage and G2’s upset victory over T1, alongside fan-created World Cup quarterfinal posters and emerging football transfer gossip. The platform reflects a passionate fusion of competitive gaming and traditional sport fandom.

- **PGS10 group stage day 2** – Fans rally behind their favourite teams in a dedicated cheering thread ( [MSN](https://news.google.) ).
- **G2 defeats T1 – rating craze** – Multiple threads ( [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9JWll1T24tTm41RXVYQXZJRjdUSlROaUFXN0RxZUpVbWF3cmNMOHFaY2pGM200bGo5am1sSi1EekFueFZTSmZHV0hkdmIxdUxBS3YyT2RGeUZWb2tBYTNFMUplQ1FHNnRnLVFSQTNud2dJQQ) , [新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1vUGVLV08zNUp5ZFR6ZHVjTHhSYTMyV1pxSEhLbWY2VjF5cXBmSGFHYWdFS1I0eXI0ZnJLdDMwQko3dktIQjlKbnRjNm1uN09VMHR6eW5WeUwyd09UQ3VaNkd1QQ) ) highlight the community’s intense reaction and user ratings.
- **World Cup quarterfinal posters** – Hupu users designed four thematic posters for the remaining matches, showcasing creative engagement ( [新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxOYXMtYld2ck8tZEIwb0ZTUVJkUUNPbWRKaEE5dEhsemRQdXk1ekhfZjJVVWZOYjdUZHdMMFR3YTNyYkJoanVnRkNNeklBU2F0Q3VTMVZCT1NDS1lOM05OS2ItelZzd0tRMFY5Q3ZKMHVaWkVyc0lKUE5aWk1aMGFjMnNB) ).
- **Transfer talk: Betis negotiating for Fran Garcia** – A Real Madrid defender could be on the move, per community sources ( [QQ News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE1taVJha3JvMXk2b0ZwX2I5ejdIYTdENE81WndLdjNMa1JqMEZ0YkRNMnp1NEl3SzhkQlRFZ29ZSzlvOFU4WXNJb3l3MHphMzhWNEZMUlBR) ).

**Signal:** 虎扑’s dual engagement with esports and football continues to drive high-volume discussions; the G2-T1 rivalry is likely to trend further as PGS10 progresses.

羽毛球.zh:
BWF世界巡回赛总决赛的筹备新闻浮出水面，虽然具体细节有限，但这一年度收官战历来是羽坛格局的试金石。随着奥运积分周期过半，各国选手正在为年终排名做最后冲刺，总决赛资格竞争趋于白热化。目前仅有这条动态，但可预见接下来将有更多抽签与参赛名单更新。
- [BWF世界巡回赛总决赛动态](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQRkhsTlRTeVNxbnk5dVhLZmJDZWRkQ1d5Q2RaS3NCNFluUnBiWmxBVnhRd0dEQXBBSzdueXdpc3ZoOUxncHpoT29yQ2F0dkFLOWFtRDRVTXUtSXB2TkxWdWZKWjNpWHB4dXR1LVhmZ0pkM0VnQ25mNFlHNzUyNS1XTzlRdmN4enVHNEVXWEFMY3ktdw)
作为全年羽坛收官大戏，总决赛的每一步动态都关乎年终排名与奖金分配，值得持续追踪。
羽毛球.en:
The badminton desk has limited activity, with only a single generic news item about the BWF World Tour Finals. No specific updates or breaking stories emerged in the last 24 hours.

- **BWF World Tour Finals** – A general news feed provides no new details ( [Google News Badminton](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQRkhsTlRTeVNxbnk5dVhLZmJDZWRkQ1d5Q2RaS3NCNFluUnBiWmxBVnhRd0dEQXBBSzdueXdpc3ZoOUxncHpoT29yQ2F0dkFLOWFtRDRVTXUtSXB2TkxWdWZKWjNpWHB4dXR1LVhmZ0pkM0VnQ25mNFlHNzUyNS1XTzlRdmN4enVHNEVXWEFMY3ktdw) ).

**Signal:** The badminton world is quiet; attention turns to upcoming World Tour Finals schedules and player preparations.

篮球.zh:
CBA休赛期，虎扑社区围绕郭艾伦的讨论再度升温。一则"郭艾伦心中"的帖子引发球迷对辽宁后卫去留的猜测，虽然缺乏官方消息，但近年来郭艾伦与俱乐部的关系微妙，每一次场外发声都被视为转会信号。当前CBA转会市场相对平静，此类社区话题恰好填补了新闻空白。
- [郭艾伦心中讨论帖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPZVoxaktXRTB3LUx4bGlmaWpuUkhUcldIbmp5R0Q4SGxrZlFtMUFNNHZac0FqYlZyaFllZlVfYlJQZHFZdVJDRDduMlpLdnRtVGNCVWkxT3Q2U2JEVFdrQUF3TmtEd0lCZUNPMFpZcDVCc3lMcVYwSFJydXNCbTk4MDAyV3dMa0xLeG85RnFJMTY4aUE)
郭艾伦的一举一动仍是CBA流量的最大来源，但缺乏实质性进展前，社区讨论更多是情绪投射。
篮球.en:
A single community post from Hupu’s CBA section captures Guo Ailun’s personal reflections on the league. The basketball desk has no major breaking news.

- **Guo Ailun’s thoughts on CBA** – A discussion thread on 虎扑 explores the star guard’s perspective on the league and his own career ( [Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxPZVoxaktXRTB3LUx4bGlmaWpuUkhUcldIbmp5R0Q4SGxrZlFtMUFNNHZac0FqYlZyaFllZlVfYlJQZHFZdVJDRDduMlpLdnRtVGNCVWkxT3Q2U2JEVFdrQUF3TmtEd0lCZUNPMFpZcDVCc3lMcVYwSFJydXNCbTk4MDAyV3dMa0xLeG85RnFJMTY4aUE) ).

**Signal:** No significant transactions or games; CBA circles remain in offseason mode, with fan discussion centred on player insights.

欧美.zh: 欧美娱乐圈今日卷入多起个人与行业层面的风波。Justin Baldoni 与 Blake Lively 的“It Ends With Us”法律战在沉寂两年后迎来男主角 [公开回应](https://deadline.com/2026/07/justin-baldoni-breaks-silence-blake-lively-legal-battle-1236978066/)，直言“有很多痛苦”。同时，CAA 对 Meta 的 AI 模型 Muse Image 发起尖锐批评，指出其默认抓取 Instagram 公开账户内容且仅提供“退出”选项，[侵犯艺人肖像权](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/digital/caa-calls-out-meta-muse-ai-video-photo-tool-instagram-1236642814/)。另外，Emmy Rossum 时隔近十年首次详谈《Shameless》片酬不公事件，称当时“很震惊”。Youn Yuh Jung 凭《Beef 2》提名艾美奖，[持续创造亚洲演员纪录](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853350wpp/youn-yuh-jung-nominated-for-78th-emmy-awards)。Netflix 系列主管透露《I Will Find You》观看量达7410万，并罕见坦承《The Boroughs》被砍原因。整体来看，欧美娱乐业正面临 AI 伦理与薪酬透明化的双重压力。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk is dominated by Emmy nomination season, a major AI privacy clash between CAA and Meta, and the aftermath of the Blake Lively–Justin Baldoni legal dispute. Disney earned 125 nominations, with Youn Yuh Jung making history, while Netflix series I Will Find You emerges as a ratings hit. The industry is also reacting to Meta’s opt-out policy for its Muse AI image generator, which CAA calls a violation of artists' rights.

- **Emmy nominations: Disney leads with 125** across ABC, FX, Hulu, and more; Youn Yuh Jung nominated for Beef 2 ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/disney-debra-oconnell-emmy-dancing-with-the-stars-fx-hulu-1236805393/), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853350wpp/youn-yuh-jung-nominated-for-78th-emmy-awards)).
- **CAA slams Meta’s Muse AI** as a privacy risk that uses public Instagram handles to generate images without explicit consent—Zuckerberg pushes back ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/digital/news/caa-slams-meta-opt-out-ai-muse-image-1236805387/), [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/caa-slams-meta-muse-image-ai-1236978047/)).
- **Justin Baldoni and wife Emily speak out** for the first time after the Blake Lively legal battle, expressing pain and injustice; Baldoni says 'there is so much more to say' ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/justin-baldoni-breaks-silence-blake-lively-legal-battle-1236978066/), [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/justin-baldoni-speaks-out-blake-lively-it-ends-with-us-1236805355/)).
- **Dune: Part Three trailer drops**: Timothée Chalamet’s Paul Atreides is a megalomaniac in a war-torn future, sparking fan excitement ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/dune-part-3-trailer-timothee-chalamet-zendaya-1235591154/)).
- **Netflix series chief defends cancelation of The Boroughs** while celebrating I Will Find You’s 74.1M views and addressing 'sophomore slump' concerns ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/the-boroughs-cancellation-virgin-river-harlan-coben-netflix-1236977993/)).

The AI and legal battles will keep the Western entertainment spotlight fixed on digital rights and celebrity accountability in the coming weeks.

日韩.zh: 韩娱今日迎来重磅选角消息：朴智贤确认与宋仲基搭档主演 KBS 新剧《Love Cloud》，[定档2027年](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853348wpp/park-ji-hyun-confirmed-to-reunite-with-song-joong-ki-in-new-romance-drama)；《Solo Leveling》真人剧则传出 Rain 与李星民正在洽谈加盟，[与边佑锡组成豪华阵容](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853349wpp/rain-in-talks-lee-sung-min-reported-to-star-in-solo-leveling-drama-adaptation-with-byeon-woo-seok)。INFINITE 成员金明洙因行程冲突缺席即将举行的粉丝见面会“INFINITE Rally V”，[所属社已发公告](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853331wpp/infinites-kim-myung-soo-l-to-sit-out-upcoming-fan-meeting-tour)。此外，《Study Group 2》主演车宇旻在拍摄动作戏时肋骨与手部受伤，[消息于今日曝光](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853231wpp/cha-woo-min-revealed-to-have-been-injured-while-filming-study-group-2)。韩剧品牌声誉榜7月排名揭晓，《Agent Kim Reactivated》登顶，反映观众对谍战题材的偏好。
日韩.en:
Korean entertainment news is buzzing with high-profile casting announcements for upcoming K-dramas and K-pop chart achievements. Park Ji Hyun will reunite with Song Joong Ki in KBS’s Love Cloud, while Rain and Lee Sung Min are in talks for the Solo Leveling adaptation. Meanwhile, INFINITE’s Kim Myung Soo will miss the group’s fan meeting tour due to scheduling conflicts, and ATEEZ secures double crowns on the Circle Chart.

- **Park Ji Hyun joins Song Joong Ki** in KBS’s new weekend miniseries Love Cloud, set for 2027 premiere ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853348wpp/park-ji-hyun-confirmed-to-reunite-with-song-joong-ki-in-new-romance-drama)).
- **Rain and Lee Sung Min reported to join Solo Leveling** drama adaptation alongside Byeon Woo Seok; Rain’s agency says 'still reviewing' ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853349wpp/rain-in-talks-lee-sung-min-reported-to-star-in-solo-leveling-drama-adaptation-with-byeon-woo-seok)).
- **July drama brand reputation rankings**: Agent Kim Reactivated tops the list, reflecting strong viewership and buzz ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853343wpp/july-drama-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-3)).
- **INFINITE’s Kim Myung Soo (L) to skip fan meeting tour** due to scheduling, disappointing fans ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853331wpp/infinites-kim-myung-soo-l-to-sit-out-upcoming-fan-meeting-tour)).
- **ATEEZ earns double crowns on Circle Chart** with mini album GOLDEN HOUR : Part.5 and title track BAD ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1853322wpp/ateez-and-cortis-earn-double-crowns-on-circle-weekly-charts)).

With Solo Leveling casting gaining momentum and drama brand rankings shifting, the K-drama landscape remains highly competitive heading into the second half of 2026.

微博社区动态.zh: 微博热搜的娱乐导向引发强烈反弹。有用户指出广西5万人受灾事件未能登上高位热搜，而[鹿晗私生活话题却占据半壁江山](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE8tdjktSlNhUHluNVllcExGYkZ0TUJPTTRKOGpXaVdDT1BVMGRyalpoOVBXa2VnQmxEOS1nN3Rsd1BMdTltVzlobVZmQTUxaTlkNkQwYWFWcExHanZKWkFSUmo2MjNmblRUT2c)，质疑平台算法与价值观。杨紫因在七七事变当日于外网发布娱乐性剧宣微博被网友“审判”，[粉丝与路人激烈对峙](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBtRW1qQy1uTlJ3aEJMc25WT1JPMHBFSWxBTlQ2bEYxQmhFUE4yb05SZTFDMUdxdzdyN1VmVHpVcGQtTnBoMDd1WTNpMnlFZnVuMWxtVU1qQzlvRnQ4Tm0ycDhoOA)。王源上海演唱会因[“胸肌”话题冲上热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE01ZVBHZ2NXc09yTTFrWGsxbGJnaUNCUEg1ZE1TT0JBaE9lNklXalZ0Z2RHZ1ZKSUhidGZLNEhkdVp1NTRLOVhMelFoZGFuNU9fRHRuN2Z4dGxrRFNyYlFJNEdYUkRWLUc2RWZxMA)，被质疑刻意营销。赵丽颖也卷入[“空降热搜”质疑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE93WnV2R2NCQWFCVmhTRlZKSVROc24wMVNRSUlKYTJHczJfN2R3MTZwYWl5M1R6dGtneGFjOG9yc19zNHpPdkZ1TDJST0lwcmJUNTNST0xJQ3VHczhQbVRYY05qTQ)，网友调侃微博“馋丽神流量”。整体而言，社区对明星热搜的免疫力正在下降，舆论场开始反噬娱乐营销。
微博社区动态.en:
Chinese Weibo is ablaze with debates over celebrity behavior and social responsibility. A major flashpoint involves Lu Han’s personal life dominating hot searches while a natural disaster in Guangxi affecting 50,000 people receives little attention. Yang Zi faces backlash for posting entertainment content on the anniversary of the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, while actors like Zhao Liying and Wang Yuan see their hot search placements questioned as possible paid promotions.

- **Lu Han’s private life trends while Guangxi flood victims ignored** — users accuse platforms of prioritizing celebrity gossip over real crises ([Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE8tdjktSlNhUHluNVllcExGYkZ0TUJPTTRKOGpXaVdDT1BVMGRyalpoOVBXa2VnQmxEOS1nN3Rsd1BMdTltVzlobVZmQTUxaTlkNkQwYWFWcExHanZKWkFSUmo2MjNmblRUT2c)).
- **Yang Zi under fire** for posting on July 7th (七七事变 anniversary) and for frequent overseas promotional hot searches; fans defend her disaster relief record ([Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBtRW1qQy1uTlJ3aEJMc25WT1JPMHBFSWxBTlQ2bEYxQmhFUE4yb05SZTFDMUdxdzdyN1VmVHpVcGQtTnBoMDd1WTNpMnlFZnVuMWxtVU1qQzlvRnQ4Tm0ycDhoOA)).
- **Zhao Liying’s hot search suspect** — netizens question whether it was a bought trend or organic ([Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE93WnV2R2NCQWFCVmhTRlZKSVROc24wMVNRSUlKYTJHczJfN2R3MTZwYWl5M1R6dGtneGFjOG9yc19zNHpPdkZ1TDJST0lwcmJUNTNST0xJQ3VHczhQbVRYY05qTQ)).
- **Wang Yuan’s concert chest muscles trend** — debate over whether it’s intentional marketing ([Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE01ZVBHZ2NXc09yTTFrWGsxbGJnaUNCUEg1ZE1TT0JBaE9lNklXalZ0Z2RHZ1ZKSUhidGZLNEhkdVp1NTRLOVhMelFoZGFuNU9fRHRuN2Z4dGxrRFNyYlFJNEdYUkRWLUc2RWZxMA)).
- **Wang Junkai and Wang Yibo name confusion** goes viral, sparking memes and discussion ([Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixgFBVV95cUxNZzBPelV0aVRybEJtSWdEMG5ONVZFaGNZRHcyYzVQSjJFdUdfQ2lXb1BGUGVVVzItSGRuamFEX0VTdTdkVmpfZ3JVbzROcHJLSmM2RW1PRW5ncnM5VHNaTkNXeVp3Zm5tZWtJLVktOW1tT0ZCeFZDdlFScERQenVKNkZuT2lNZ3pXa1gtN3ZkRmJ0TGc4MVZoOGl3NjZsTGF3NW1BQjJUY0pxM0ZZUllQU2p0VVNneEZmSXlFSkdMNldPTVR5Wnc)).

The tension between entertainment content and national memory days continues to polarize Chinese netizens, with implications for brand endorsements and artist reputations.

中国.zh: 中国娱乐圈今日释放多重新信号。一则“明星集体失业”的报道称横店影视基地拍摄量骤减，[“中国好莱坞”变冷清](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9ock1Id3FKX1BCdHVaN2JMTDNURkEtM2JYdUVpLUVpZWJOS2tlN0Z5T0FjS3BWMWt1eW96Q0JCcHA3RmxRaGhFakFyMXpiM2pQWk9BTDZ6SURuZnlyb0HSAWNBVV95cUxPMjN6b0JINmNtM3pRWVh3RTJHcU9DVEE2MzFnQXJwZUstT3JLU0lXanNPSUpyeGNYREdDbXRLOEQtaHFiaUVSYTRyNmtLR0FLWG9qcFFZdnUwMGc0bmpnNXZveHc)，引发行业前景担忧。与此同时，曾因逃税消失四年的某知名男星突然登上杂志封面，[被疑准备复出](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9XU2Jqb09vSFh4UnFjWWoxUHNjUklBanVJZ09LQkwwVk9jSFo4QmdmVWRiSW1EUEw0NGxZTV9QT1ludVNjb05mUWcxaHRKVmNGV1FhMWI0RzdMWUlYQi1xQ3ZlNlVlVllwTThxUWhTYS1oZUht)。NCT 中国成员昀昀正式宣布退出组合并与 SM 娱乐终止合约，[引发中韩粉丝热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFBndkFjQTlTbUs5bjl3SW0tSm5TRXBERndacC15TTRaWEhORnNfT2hqSXQwWEpfSHc0OVBKb1k5dS14U0s3eTZDcnRmZ0FvSm9PSjVIR0lWMlFWdWlJVVM00gFkQVVfeXFMTUlxNXF0ajZ4RGxpc3EtcU85a3ZwYlRxWTVCVWFKczE5SWUxdlVhSWhMM0tYWFdRY1E5aGhVMHVhaURVak5EWTByU3J5R3h0blpWT0hxUG9JU2x2ODFuV0FuSXpUZA)。Angelababy 在秀场认出粉丝并挑眉致意，[被赞“内娱最会爱人”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQcXdySFRRUlBrWnlsUG0wTzVKaTdTaEJFOC1PNkNTUTh4T092WGhhdEp0YWNlWUZtUUhYRVBwLUlzWG91V09veFN0LXBST3g3YWN3Y3B5Q2h2dnFOd0R2aWs1NEhidGJvdVpqSnRZQndBbGdEM2FmNkdUbGF6LVBGN055dllMVUNreEhkWQ)。整体来看，行业面临头部艺人出走、税收监管余波与产能过剩的三重考验。
中国.en:
China's entertainment desk reports mixed signals: while the '时尚中国之夜' event draws star power and the film industry celebrates the Chinese Film Director Night, a narrative of industry downturn is gaining traction. Reports claim 'Chinese Hollywood is empty' with many stars unemployed, and a tax-evading male star resurfacing after four years fuels speculation about a comeback. Meanwhile, NCT’s Winwin (昀昀) officially terminates his contract with SM Entertainment, signaling ongoing shifts in K-pop's connection to Chinese idols.

- **Stars 'collectively unemployed'?** — Multiple sources describe a hollowing out of the entertainment industry, with fewer productions and idle talent ([aboluowang](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9ock1Id3FKX1BCdHVaN2JMTDNURkEtM2JYdUVpLUVpZWJOS2tlN0Z5T0FjS3BWMWt1eW96Q0JCcHA3RmxRaGhFakFyMXpiM2pQWk9BTDZ6SURuZnlyb0HSAWNBVV95cUxPMjN6b0JINmNtM3pRWVh3RTJHcU9DVEE2MzFnQXJwZUstT3JLU0lXanNPSUpyeGNYREdDbXRLOEQtaHFiaUVSYTRyNmtLR0FLWG9qcFFZdnUwMGc0bmpnNXZveHc), [lookchina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE9iZ2xobV8wbFNRU3VlVWxtaERNNEVpT3ZQa1FiTnBLN24ycjVVaTZuYkxza09RS09YWG04SkdXNzV0LU5wLTM4QWtmQ0gtRzU5cWNkQ29iMmxxdmpNc1M5WmJpWUZ3eFU0d2NN)).
- **Tax-evading male star returns** after four years with a magazine cover, hinting at a possible comeback; details of his identity not fully revealed in the source ([Rojaklah](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE9XU2Jqb09vSFh4UnFjWWoxUHNjUklBanVJZ09LQkwwVk9jSFo4QmdmVWRiSW1EUEw0NGxZTV9QT1ludVNjb05mUWcxaHRKVmNGV1FhMWI0RzdMWUlYQi1xQ3ZlNlVlVllwTThxUWhTYS1oZUht)).
- **NCT’s Winwin leaves SM Entertainment** and terminates his contract, affecting the group’s Chinese fanbase ([大纪元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFBndkFjQTlTbUs5bjl3SW0tSm5TRXBERndacC15TTRaWEhORnNfT2hqSXQwWEpfSHc0OVBKb1k5dS14U0s3eTZDcnRmZ0FvSm9PSjVIR0lWMlFWdWlJVVM00gFkQVVfeXFMTUlxNXF0ajZ4RGxpc3EtcU85a3ZwYlRxWTVCVWFKczE5SWUxdlVhSWhMM0tYWFdRY1E5aGhVMHVhaURVak5EWTByU3J5R3h0blpWT0hxUG9JU2x2ODFuV0FuSXpUZA)).
- **Angelababy’s warm fan moment at a fashion show** goes viral, praised as 'the most loving in Chinese entertainment' ([Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQcXdySFRRUlBrWnlsUG0wTzVKaTdTaEJFOC1PNkNTUTh4T092WGhhdEp0YWNlWUZtUUhYRVBwLUlzWG91V09veFN0LXBST3g3YWN3Y3B5Q2h2dnFOd0R2aWs1NEhidGJvdVpqSnRZQndBbGdEM2FmNkdUbGF6LVBGN055dllMVUNreEhkWQ)).

Whether the 'empty Hollywood' narrative is an exaggeration or a real trend, the resurfacing of a previously blacklisted star and the departure of a K-pop Chinese member signal ongoing turbulence in the cross-strait entertainment ecosystem.
